1.11.s:
śrīkūrma uvāca
evaṃ sṛṣṭvā parīcyādīn devadevaḥ pitāmahaḥ /
sahaiva mānasaiḥ putraistatāpa paramaṃ tapaḥ //
1.11.d:
श्रीकूर्म उवाच
एवं सृष्ट्वा परीच्यादीन् देवदेवः पितामहः ।
सहैव मानसैः पुत्रैस्तताप परमं तपः ॥
1.11.m: The holy Kūrma said: / Having thus created Marīci and the others, the God of gods, the Grandfather, / together with his mind-born sons, performed supreme asceticism.

1.11.s:
tasyaivaṃ tapato vaktrād rudraḥ kālāgnisannibhaḥ /
triśūlapāṇirīśānaḥ pradurāsīt trilocanaḥ //
1.11.d:
तस्यैवं तपतो वक्त्राद् रुद्रः कालाग्निसन्निभः ।
त्रिशूलपाणिरीशानः प्रदुरासीत् त्रिलोचनः ॥
1.11.m: As he was thus performing asceticism, from his mouth Rudra, resembling the fire of cosmic dissolution, / trident in hand, Īśāna, the three-eyed one, appeared,

1.11.s:
ardhanārīnaravapuḥ duṣprekṣyo 'tibhayaṅkaraḥ /
vibhajātmānamityuktvā brahmā cāntardadhe bhayāt //
1.11.d:
अर्धनारीनरवपुः दुष्प्रेक्ष्यो ऽतिभयङ्करः ।
विभजात्मानमित्युक्त्वा ब्रह्मा चान्तर्दधे भयात् ॥
1.11.m: possessing a body half-female and half-male, difficult to behold, exceedingly terrifying. / Saying, "Divide yourself!", Brahmā vanished out of fear.

1.11.s:
tathokto 'sau dvidhā strītvaṃ puruṣatvamathākarot /
bibheda puruṣatvaṃ ca daśadhā caikadhā punaḥ //
1.11.d:
तथोक्तो ऽसौ द्विधा स्त्रीत्वं पुरुषत्वमथाकरोत् ।
बिभेद पुरुषत्वं च दशधा चैकधा पुनः ॥
1.11.m: Thus addressed, he then made [himself] two-fold: female and male; / and he divided his maleness tenfold and once more into one.

1.11.s:
ekādaśaite kathitā rudrāstribhuvaneśvarāḥ /
kapālośādayo viprā devakārye niyojitāḥ //
1.11.d:
एकादशैते कथिता रुद्रास्त्रिभुवनेश्वराः ।
कपालोशादयो विप्रा देवकार्ये नियोजिताः ॥
1.11.m: These eleven Rudras are spoken of as the lords of the three worlds; / Kapālin and the others, O brāhmaṇas, were appointed to the business of the gods.

1.11.s:
saumyāsaumyaistathā śāntāśāntaiḥ strītvaṃ ca sa prabhuḥ /
bibheda bahudhā devaḥ svarūpairasitaiḥ sitaiḥ //
1.11.d:
सौम्यासौम्यैस्तथा शान्ताशान्तैः स्त्रीत्वं च स प्रभुः ।
बिभेद बहुधा देवः स्वरूपैरसितैः सितैः ॥
1.11.m: And that lord divided his femaleness manifold / into mild and fierce, peaceful and unpeaceful, dark and light forms, the god [did so].

1.11.s:
tā vai vibhūtayo viprā viśrutāḥ śaktayo bhuvi /
lakṣmyādayo yābhirīśā viśvaṃvyāpnoti śāṅkarī //
1.11.d:
ता वै विभूतयो विप्रा विश्रुताः शक्तयो भुवि ।
लक्ष्म्यादयो याभिरीशा विश्वंव्याप्नोति शाङ्करी ॥
1.11.m: Those indeed are the famed manifestations on earth, O brāhmaṇas, the powers / beginning with Lakṣmī, by which the sovereign Śāṅkarī pervades the universe.

1.11.s:
vibhajya purarīśānī svātmānaṃ śaṅkarād vibhoḥ /
mahādevaniyogena pitāmahamupasthitā //
1.11.d:
विभज्य पुररीशानी स्वात्मानं शङ्कराद् विभोः ।
महादेवनियोगेन पितामहमुपस्थिता ॥
1.11.m: Having further divided herself from the all-pervading Śaṅkara, Īśānī, / by the command of Mahādeva, stood before the Grandfather.

1.11.s:
tāmāha bhagavān brahmā dakṣasya duhitā bhava /
sāpi tasya niyogena prādurāsīt prajāpateḥ //
1.11.d:
तामाह भगवान् ब्रह्मा दक्षस्य दुहिता भव ।
सापि तस्य नियोगेन प्रादुरासीत् प्रजापतेः ॥
1.11.m: The Lord Brahmā said to her: "Become the daughter of Dakṣa." / She too, by his command, was born of that lord of creatures.

1.11.s:
niyogād brahmaṇo devīṃ dadau rudrāya tāṃ satīm /
dakṣād rudro 'pi jagrāha svakīyāmeva śūlabhṛt //
1.11.d:
नियोगाद् ब्रह्मणो देवीं ददौ रुद्राय तां सतीम् ।
दक्षाद् रुद्रो ऽपि जग्राह स्वकीयामेव शूलभृत् ॥
1.11.m: By the command of Brahmā, he gave the goddess, Satī, to Rudra; / and the trident-wielder Rudra also received her from Dakṣa as his very own.

1.11.s:
prajāpatiṃ vinindyaiṣā kālena parameśvarī /
menāyāmabhavat putrī tadā himavataḥ satī //
1.11.d:
प्रजापतिं विनिन्द्यैषा कालेन परमेश्वरी ।
मेनायामभवत् पुत्री तदा हिमवतः सती ॥
1.11.m: Having reproached that lord of creatures, this supreme sovereign Satī in the course of time / then became the daughter of the Himavat in Menā.

1.11.s:
sa cāpi parvatavaro dadau rudrāya pārvatīm /
hitāya sarvadevānāṃ trilokasyātmano 'pi ca //
1.11.d:
स चापि पर्वतवरो ददौ रुद्राय पार्वतीम् ।
हिताय सर्वदेवानां त्रिलोकस्यात्मनो ऽपि च ॥
1.11.m: And that best of mountains gave Pārvatī to Rudra / for the welfare of all the gods, of the three worlds, and of himself.

1.11.s:
saiṣā māheśvarī devī śaṅkarārdhaśarīriṇī /
śivā satī haimavatī surāsuranamaskṛtā //
1.11.d:
सैषा माहेश्वरी देवी शङ्करार्धशरीरिणी ।
शिवा सती हैमवती सुरासुरनमस्कृता ॥
1.11.m: This is that Māheśvarī goddess, who forms half the body of Śaṅkarā, / Śivā, Satī, Haimavatī, bowed to by gods and asuras.

1.11.s:
tasyāḥ prabhāvamatulaṃ sarve devāḥ savāsavāḥ /
vindanti munayo vetti śaṅkaro vā svayaṃ hariḥ //
1.11.d:
तस्याः प्रभावमतुलं सर्वे देवाः सवासवाः ।
विन्दन्ति मुनयो वेत्ति शङ्करो वा स्वयं हरिः ॥
1.11.m: Her peerless power all the gods together with Indra, / the sages comprehend, or Śaṅkara knows it, or Hari himself.

1.11.s:
etad vaḥ kathitaṃ viprāḥ putratvaṃ parameṣṭhinaḥ /
brahmaṇaḥ padmayonitvaṃ śaṅkarasyāmitaujasaḥ //
1.11.d:
एतद् वः कथितं विप्राः पुत्रत्वं परमेष्ठिनः ।
ब्रह्मणः पद्मयोनित्वं शङ्करस्यामितौजसः ॥
1.11.m: This has been told to you, O brāhmaṇas: the sonship of the Supreme Lord, / Brahmā's lotus-born state, and [the origin] of Śaṅkara of immeasurable splendour.

1.11.s:
sūta uvāca
ityākarṇyātha munayaḥ kūrmarūpeṇa bhāṣitam /
viṣṇunā punarevainaṃ praṇatā harim //
1.11.d:
सूत उवाच
इत्याकर्ण्याथ मुनयः कूर्मरूपेण भाषितम् ।
विष्णुना पुनरेवैनं प्रणता हरिम् ॥
1.11.m: Sūta said: / Then, having heard what was spoken by Viṣṇu embodied as a tortoise, / the sages bowed once again to this Hari.

1.11.s:
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
kaiṣā bhagavatī devī śaṅkarārdhaśarīriṇī /
śivā satī haimavatī yathāvad brūhi pṛcchatām //
1.11.d:
ऋषय ऊचुः
कैषा भगवती देवी शङ्करार्धशरीरिणी ।
शिवा सती हैमवती यथावद् ब्रूहि पृच्छताम् ॥
1.11.m: The sages said: / Who is this divine goddess who forms half the body of Śaṅkarā, / Śivā, Satī, Haimavatī? Tell this properly to us who ask.

1.11.s:
teṣāṃ tad vacanaṃ śrutvā munīnāṃ puruṣottamaḥ /
pratyuvāca mahāyogī dhyātvā svaṃ paramaṃ padam //
1.11.d:
तेषां तद् वचनं श्रुत्वा मुनीनां पुरुषोत्तमः ।
प्रत्युवाच महायोगी ध्यात्वा स्वं परमं पदम् ॥
1.11.m: Having heard those words of the sages, the Supreme Spirit, / the great yogin, having meditated upon his supreme state, replied.

1.11.s:
śrīkūrma uvāca
purā pitāmahenoktaṃ merupṛṣṭhe suśobhanam /
rahasyametad vijñānaṃ gopanīyaṃ viśeṣataḥ //
1.11.d:
श्रीकूर्म उवाच
पुरा पितामहेनोक्तं मेरुपृष्ठे सुशोभनम् ।
रहस्यमेतद् विज्ञानं गोपनीयं विशेषतः ॥
1.11.m: The holy Kūrma said: / Formerly, on the ridge of Mount Meru, the Grandfather spoke this auspicious, / secret wisdom, which is to be especially concealed,

1.11.s:
sāṃkhyānāṃ paramaṃ sāṃkhyaṃ brahmavijñānamuttamam /
saṃsārārṇavamagnānāṃ jantūnāmekamocanam //
1.11.d:
सांख्यानां परमं सांख्यं ब्रह्मविज्ञानमुत्तमम् ।
संसारार्णवमग्नानां जन्तूनामेकमोचनम् ॥
1.11.m: the supreme doctrine of the Sāṃkhyas, the highest knowledge of Brahman, / the sole deliverance of creatures drowned in the ocean of transmigratory existence:

1.11.s:
yā sā māheśvarī śaktirjñānarūpātilālasā /
vyomasaṃjñā parā kāṣṭhā seyaṃ haimavatī matā //
1.11.d:
या सा माहेश्वरी शक्तिर्ज्ञानरूपातिलालसा ।
व्योमसंज्ञा परा काष्ठा सेयं हैमवती मता ॥
1.11.m: That which is the power of Maheśvara, consisting of knowledge, full of intense longing, / named Space, the supreme limit—she is regarded as this Haimavatī.

1.11.s:
śivā sarvagatānāntā guṇātītā suniṣkalā /
ekānekavibhāgasthā jñānarūpātilālasā //
1.11.d:
शिवा सर्वगतानान्ता गुणातीता सुनिष्कला ।
एकानेकविभागस्था ज्ञानरूपातिलालसा ॥
1.11.m: Auspicious, all-pervading, endless, beyond the qualities, thoroughly partless, / abiding in division single and manifold, consisting of knowledge, full of intense longing,

1.11.s:
ananyā niṣkale tattve saṃsthitā tasya tejasā /
svābhāvikī ca tanmūlā prabhā bhānorivāmalā //
1.11.d:
अनन्या निष्कले तत्त्वे संस्थिता तस्य तेजसा ।
स्वाभाविकी च तन्मूला प्रभा भानोरिवामला ॥
1.11.m: not different from the partless reality, standing by his radiance, / innate and rooted in him, like the spotless light of the sun.

1.11.s:
ekā māheśvarī śaktiranekopādhiyogataḥ /
parāvareṇa rūpeṇa krīḍate tasya sannidhau //
1.11.d:
एका माहेश्वरी शक्तिरनेकोपाधियोगतः ।
परावरेण रूपेण क्रीडते तस्य सन्निधौ ॥
1.11.m: The one power of Maheśvara, through association with diverse limiting conditions, / plays in his presence in higher and lower forms.

1.11.s:
seyaṃ karoti sakalaṃ tasyāḥ kāryamidaṃ jagat /
na kāryaṃ nāpi karaṇamīśvarasyeti sūrayaḥ //
1.11.d:
सेयं करोति सकलं तस्याः कार्यमिदं जगत् ।
न कार्यं नापि करणमीश्वरस्येति सूरयः ॥
1.11.m: She makes everything; this universe is her effect; / the Lord has neither an effect nor an instrument—so say the wise.

1.11.s:
catastraḥ śaktayo devyāḥ svarūpatvena saṃsthitāḥ /
adhiṣṭhānavaśāt tasyāḥ śṛṇudhvaṃ munipuṅgavāḥ //
1.11.d:
चतस्त्रः शक्तयो देव्याः स्वरूपत्वेन संस्थिताः ।
अधिष्ठानवशात् तस्याः शृणुध्वं मुनिपुङ्गवाः ॥
1.11.m: Four are the powers of the goddess, abiding in their own nature, / by virtue of her presiding presence; hear [of them], O best of sages:

1.11.s:
śāntirvidyā pratiṣṭhā ca nivṛttiścetitāḥ smṛtaḥ /
caturvyūhastato devaḥ procyate parameśvaraḥ //
1.11.d:
शान्तिर्विद्या प्रतिष्ठा च निवृत्तिश्चेतिताः स्मृतः ।
चतुर्व्यूहस्ततो देवः प्रोच्यते परमेश्वरः ॥
1.11.m: They are traditionally remembered as Śānti, Vidyā, Pratiṣṭhā, and Nivṛtti; / therefore the god, the Supreme Lord, is spoken of as having a fourfold manifestation.

1.11.s:
anayā parayā devaḥ svātmānandaṃ samaśnute /
caturṣvapi ca vedeṣu caturmūrtirmaheśvaraḥ //
1.11.d:
अनया परया देवः स्वात्मानन्दं समश्नुते ।
चतुर्ष्वपि च वेदेषु चतुर्मूर्तिर्महेश्वरः ॥
1.11.m: Through this supreme [power], the god enjoys the bliss of his own self; / and in all four Vedas, Maheśvara has four forms.

1.11.s:
asyāstvanādisaṃsiddhamaiśvaryamatulaṃ mahat /
tatsambandhādanantāyā rudreṇa paramātmanā //
1.11.d:
अस्यास्त्वनादिसंसिद्धमैश्वर्यमतुलं महत् ।
तत्सम्बन्धादनन्ताया रुद्रेण परमात्मना ॥
1.11.m: Her peerless, great sovereignty is established from beginninglessness, / through the connection of this endless one with Rudra, the Supreme Self.

1.11.s:
saiṣā sarveśvarī devī sarvabhūtapravartikā /
procyate bhagavān kālo hariḥ prāṇo maheśvaraḥ //
1.11.d:
सैषा सर्वेश्वरी देवी सर्वभूतप्रवर्तिका ।
प्रोच्यते भगवान् कालो हरिः प्राणो महेश्वरः ॥
1.11.m: This is that goddess, sovereign of all, the impeller of all beings; / the Lord is spoken of as Time, Hari, Breath, Maheśvara.

1.11.s:
tatra sarvamidaṃ protamotaṃ caivākhilaṃ jagat /
sa kālo 'gnirharo rudro gīyate vedavādibhiḥ //
1.11.d:
तत्र सर्वमिदं प्रोतमोतं चैवाखिलं जगत् ।
स कालो ऽग्निर्हरो रुद्रो गीयते वेदवादिभिः ॥
1.11.m: In that this whole world is woven lengthwise and crosswise; / he is sung as Time, Fire, Hara, and Rudra by the proclaimers of the Veda.

1.11.s:
kālaḥ sṛjati bhūtāni kālaḥ saṃharate prajāḥ /
sarve kālasya vaśagā na kālaḥ kasyacid vaśe //
1.11.d:
कालः सृजति भूतानि कालः संहरते प्रजाः ।
सर्वे कालस्य वशगा न कालः कस्यचिद् वशे ॥
1.11.m: Time creates beings; Time destroys creatures; / all are under the control of Time; Time is under no one's control.

1.11.s:
pradhānaṃ puruṣastattvaṃ mahānātmā tvahaṅkṛtiḥ /
kālenānyāni tattvāni samāviṣṭāni yoginā //
1.11.d:
प्रधानं पुरुषस्तत्त्वं महानात्मा त्वहङ्कृतिः ।
कालेनान्यानि तत्त्वानि समाविष्टानि योगिना ॥
1.11.m: Pradhāna, Puruṣa, reality, the Great Self, and the ego-principle, / and other principles are pervaded by Time, the yogin.

1.11.s:
tasya sarvajagatsūtiḥ śaktirmāyeti viśrutā /
tayedaṃ bhrāmayedīśo māyāvī puruṣottamaḥ //
1.11.d:
तस्य सर्वजगत्सूतिः शक्तिर्मायेति विश्रुता ।
तयेदं भ्रामयेदीशो मायावी पुरुषोत्तमः ॥
1.11.m: His power, the source of all the universe, is known as Māyā; / through it, the Lord, the possessor of illusory creative power, the Supreme Spirit, causes this [world] to revolve.

1.11.s:
saiṣā māyātmikā śaktiḥ sarvākārā sanātanī /
vaiśvarūpyaṃ maheśasya sarvadā saṃprakāśayet //
1.11.d:
सैषा मायात्मिका शक्तिः सर्वाकारा सनातनी ।
वैश्वरूप्यं महेशस्य सर्वदा संप्रकाशयेत् ॥
1.11.m: This eternal power, consisting of illusory creative power, possessing all forms, / constantly illuminates the universal form of the great lord.

1.11.s:
anyāśca śaktayo mukhyāstasya devasya nirmitāḥ /
jñānaśaktiḥ kriyāśaktiḥ prāṇaśaktiriti trayam //
1.11.d:
अन्याश्च शक्तयो मुख्यास्तस्य देवस्य निर्मिताः ।
ज्ञानशक्तिः क्रियाशक्तिः प्राणशक्तिरिति त्रयम् ॥
1.11.m: And other principal powers of that god are produced: / the power of knowledge, the power of action, and the power of breath—the triad.

1.11.s:
sarvāsāmeva śaktīnāṃ śaktimanto vinirmitāḥ /
māyayaivātha viprendrāḥ sā cānādiranantayā //
1.11.d:
सर्वासामेव शक्तीनां शक्तिमन्तो विनिर्मिताः ।
माययैवाथ विप्रेन्द्राः सा चानादिरनन्तया ॥
1.11.m: The wielders of all these powers were created / through that very illusory creative power, O best of brāhmaṇas, and she is beginningless and endless.

1.11.s:
sarvaśaktyātmikā māyā durnivārā duratyayā /
māyāvī sarvaśaktīśaḥ kālaḥ kālakāraḥ prabhuḥ //
1.11.d:
सर्वशक्त्यात्मिका माया दुर्निवारा दुरत्यया ।
मायावी सर्वशक्तीशः कालः कालकारः प्रभुः ॥
1.11.m: Māyā, consisting of all powers, is hard to avert, difficult to cross; / the master of illusory creative power, the lord of all powers is Time, the maker of time, the sovereign.

1.11.s:
karoti kālaḥ sakalaṃ saṃharet kāla eva hi /
kālaḥ sthāpayate viśvaṃ kālādhīnamidaṃ jagat //
1.11.d:
करोति कालः सकलं संहरेत् काल एव हि ।
कालः स्थापयते विश्वं कालाधीनमिदं जगत् ॥
1.11.m: Time makes everything; Time alone dissolves [it]; / Time sustains the universe; this world is subject to Time,

1.11.s:
labdhvā devādhidevasya sannidhiṃ parameṣṭhinaḥ /
anantasyākhileśasya śaṃbhoḥ kālātmanaḥ prabhoḥ //
1.11.d:
लब्ध्वा देवाधिदेवस्य सन्निधिं परमेष्ठिनः ।
अनन्तस्याखिलेशस्य शंभोः कालात्मनः प्रभोः ॥
1.11.m: having attained the presence of the God over gods, the supreme sovereign, / of the infinite one, the lord of all, of Śambhu, whose nature is Time, the sovereign.

1.11.s:
pradhānaṃ puruṣo māyā māyā caivaṃ prapadyate /
ekā sarvagatānantā kevalā niṣkalā śivā //
1.11.d:
प्रधानं पुरुषो माया माया चैवं प्रपद्यते ।
एका सर्वगतानन्ता केवला निष्कला शिवा ॥
1.11.m:
Primary matter, the spirit, and the illusory creative power—and thus illusory creative power is known:
one, all-pervading, infinite, absolute, without parts, auspicious.

1.11.s:
ekā śaktiḥ śivaiko 'pi śaktimānucyate śivaḥ /
śaktayaḥ śaktimanto 'nye sarvaśaktisamudbhavāḥ //
1.11.d:
एका शक्तिः शिवैको ऽपि शक्तिमानुच्यते शिवः ।
शक्तयः शक्तिमन्तो ऽन्ये सर्वशक्तिसमुद्भवाः ॥
1.11.m:
The power is one, and Śiva, though also one, is called the possessor of power;
other powers and possessors of power are born from the source of all powers.

1.11.s:
śaktiśaktimatorbhedaṃ vadanti paramārthataḥ /
abhedaṃ cānupaśyanti yoginastattvacintakāḥ //
1.11.d:
शक्तिशक्तिमतोर्भेदं वदन्ति परमार्थतः ।
अभेदं चानुपश्यन्ति योगिनस्तत्त्वचिन्तकाः ॥
1.11.m:
They speak of a difference between power and the possessor of power in ultimate reality,
and yet yogins who contemplate reality see their non-difference.

1.11.s:
śaktayo girajā devī śaktimanto 'tha śaṅkaraḥ /
viśeṣaḥ kathyate cāyaṃ purāṇe brahmavādibhiḥ //
1.11.d:
शक्तयो गिरजा देवी शक्तिमन्तो ऽथ शङ्करः ।
विशेषः कथ्यते चायं पुराणे ब्रह्मवादिभिः ॥
1.11.m:
The goddess born of the mountain is the powers, and Śaṅkara is the possessor of powers;
and this distinction is proclaimed in the Purāṇa by knowers of Brahman.

1.11.s:
bhogyā viśveśvarī devī maheśvarapativratā /
procyate bhagavān bhoktā kaparde nīlalohitaḥ //
1.11.d:
भोग्या विश्वेश्वरी देवी महेश्वरपतिव्रता ।
प्रोच्यते भगवान् भोक्ता कपर्दे नीललोहितः ॥
1.11.m:
The sovereign goddess of the universe, devoted to Maheśvara, is the object of enjoyment;
the Lord who wears matted hair, the dark-blue and red one, is called the enjoyer.

1.11.s:
mantā viśveśvaro devaḥ śaṅkaro manmathāntakaḥ /
procyate matirīśānī mantavyā ca vicārataḥ //
1.11.d:
मन्ता विश्वेश्वरो देवः शङ्करो मन्मथान्तकः ।
प्रोच्यते मतिरीशानी मन्तव्या च विचारतः ॥
1.11.m:
The divine Lord of the universe, Śaṅkara, destroyer of the god of love, is the thinker;
the sovereign Lady is said to be the intellect, and upon reflection, the object of thought.

1.11.s:
ityetadakhilaṃ viprāḥ śaktiśaktimadudbhavam /
procyate sarvavedeṣu munibhistattvadarśibhiḥ //
1.11.d:
इत्येतदखिलं विप्राः शक्तिशक्तिमदुद्भवम् ।
प्रोच्यते सर्ववेदेषु मुनिभिस्तत्त्वदर्शिभिः ॥
1.11.m:
All this, O Brahmins, born of power and the possessor of power,
is declared in all the Vedas by sages who perceive the truth.

1.11.s:
etat pradarśitaṃ divyaṃ devyā māhātmyamuttamam /
sarvavedāntavedeṣu niścitaṃ brahmavādibhiḥ //
1.11.d:
एतत् प्रदर्शितं दिव्यं देव्या माहात्म्यमुत्तमम् ।
सर्ववेदान्तवेदेषु निश्चितं ब्रह्मवादिभिः ॥
1.11.m:
This divine and supreme majesty of the goddess has been demonstrated,
ascertained in all the Upanishads and the Vedas by knowers of Brahman.

1.11.s:
ekaṃ sarvagataṃ sūkṣmaṃ kūṭasthamacalaṃ dhruvam /
yoginastat prapaśyanti mahādevyāḥ paraṃ padam //
1.11.d:
एकं सर्वगतं सूक्ष्मं कूटस्थमचलं ध्रुवम् ।
योगिनस्तत् प्रपश्यन्ति महादेव्याः परं पदम् ॥
1.11.m:
One, all-pervading, subtle, immovable, unchanging, and constant—
that supreme state of the Great Goddess, yogins perceive.

1.11.s:
ānandamakṣaraṃ brahma kevalaṃ niṣkalaṃ param /
yoginastat prapaśyanti mahādevyāḥ paraṃ padam //
1.11.d:
आनन्दमक्षरं ब्रह्म केवलं निष्कलं परम् ।
योगिनस्तत् प्रपश्यन्ति महादेव्याः परं पदम् ॥
1.11.m:
Blissful, imperishable Brahman, absolute, without parts, supreme—
that supreme state of the Great Goddess, yogins perceive.

1.11.s:
parātparataraṃ tattvaṃ śāśvataṃ śivamacyutam /
anantaprakṛtau līnaṃ devyāstat paramaṃ padam //
1.11.d:
परात्परतरं तत्त्वं शाश्वतं शिवमच्युतम् ।
अनन्तप्रकृतौ लीनं देव्यास्तत् परमं पदम् ॥
1.11.m:
A reality higher than the highest, eternal, auspicious, infallible,
absorbed in infinite primordial matter—that is the supreme state of the goddess.

1.11.s:
śubhaṃ nirañjanaṃ śuddhaṃ nirguṇaṃ dvaitavarjitam /
ātmopalabdhiviṣayaṃ devyāstat paramaṃ padam //
1.11.d:
शुभं निरञ्जनं शुद्धं निर्गुणं द्वैतवर्जितम् ।
आत्मोपलब्धिविषयं देव्यास्तत् परमं पदम् ॥
1.11.m:
Auspicious, spotless, pure, beyond qualities, devoid of duality,
the object of the realization of the Self—that is the supreme state of the goddess.

1.11.s:
saiṣā dhātrī vidhātrī ca paramānandamicchatām /
saṃsāratāpānakhilān nihantīśvarasaṃśrayā //
1.11.d:
सैषा धात्री विधात्री च परमानन्दमिच्छताम् ।
संसारतापानखिलान् निहन्तीश्वरसंश्रया ॥
1.11.m:
She is the sustainer and creator for those who desire supreme bliss;
taking refuge in the Lord, she destroys all the afflictions of worldly existence.

1.11.s:
tasmād vimuktimanvicchan pārvatīṃ parameśvarīm /
āśrayet sarvabhāvānāmātmabhūtāṃ śivātmikām //
1.11.d:
तस्माद् विमुक्तिमन्विच्छन् पार्वतीं परमेश्वरीम् ।
आश्रयेत् सर्वभावानामात्मभूतां शिवात्मिकाम् ॥
1.11.m:
Therefore, seeking complete liberation, one should take refuge in Pārvatī, the supreme sovereign,
who is the Self of all states of being, whose nature is Śiva.

1.11.s:
labdhvā ca putrīṃ śarvāṇīṃ tapastaptvā suduścaram /
sabhāryaḥ śaraṃ yātaḥ pārvatīṃ parameśvarīm //
1.11.d:
लब्ध्वा च पुत्रीं शर्वाणीं तपस्तप्त्वा सुदुश्चरम् ।
सभार्यः शरं यातः पार्वतीं परमेश्वरीम् ॥
1.11.m:
Having obtained Śarvāṇī as a daughter after performing very severe austerities,
[Himavat], together with his wife, went for refuge to Pārvatī, the supreme sovereign.

1.11.s:
tāṃ dṛṣṭvā jāyamānāṃ ca svecchayaiva varānanām /
menā himavataḥ patnī prāhedaṃ parvateśvaram //
1.11.d:
तां दृष्ट्वा जायमानां च स्वेच्छयैव वराननाम् ।
मेना हिमवतः पत्नी प्राहेदं पर्वतेश्वरम् ॥
1.11.m:
Seeing that fair-faced lady being born by her own free will,
Menā, the wife of Himavat, said this to the lord of mountains:

1.11.s:
menovāca
paśya bālāmimāṃ rājan rājīvasadṛśānanām /
hitāya sarvabhūtānāṃ jātā ca tapasāvayoḥ //
1.11.d:
मेनोवाच
पश्य बालामिमां राजन् राजीवसदृशाननाम् ।
हिताय सर्वभूतानां जाता च तपसावयोः ॥
1.11.m: Menā said: / Look at this girl, O King, whose face resembles a lotus; / for the welfare of all beings she is born through the austerity of us two.

1.11.s:
so 'pi dṛṣṭvā tataḥ putrīṃ taruṇādityasannibhām /
kapardinīṃ caturvaktrāṃ trinetrāmatilālasām //
1.11.d:
सो ऽपि दृष्ट्वा ततः पुत्रीं तरुणादित्यसन्निभाम् ।
कपर्दिनीं चतुर्वक्त्रां त्रिनेत्रामतिलालसाम् ॥
1.11.m: Then, seeing his daughter resembling the morning sun, / wearing matted locks, four-faced, three-eyed, intensely eager,

1.11.s:
aṣṭahastāṃ viśālākṣīṃ candrāvayavabhūṣaṇām /
nirguṇāṃ saguṇāṃ sākṣāt sadasadvyaktivarjitām //
1.11.d:
अष्टहस्तां विशालाक्षीं चन्द्रावयवभूषणाम् ।
निर्गुणां सगुणां साक्षात् सदसद्व्यक्तिवर्जिताम् ॥
1.11.m: eight-armed, large-eyed, adorned with the crescent moon, / without qualities and yet directly endowed with qualities, free from the manifestation of existence and non-existence,

1.11.s:
praṇamya śirasā bhūmau tejasā cātivihvalaḥ /
bhītaḥ kṛtāñjalistasyāḥ provāca parameśvarīm //
1.11.d:
प्रणम्य शिरसा भूमौ तेजसा चातिविह्वलः ।
भीतः कृताञ्जलिस्तस्याः प्रोवाच परमेश्वरीम् ॥
1.11.m: bowing his head to the ground, extremely overwhelmed by her splendor, / frightened, he spoke with joined palms to that supreme sovereign.

1.11.s:
hīmavānuvāca
kā tvaṃ devi viśālākṣi śaśāṅkāvayavāṅkite /
na jāne tvāmahaṃ vatse yathāvad brūhi pṛcchate //
1.11.d:
हीमवानुवाच
का त्वं देवि विशालाक्षि शशाङ्कावयवाङ्किते ।
न जाने त्वामहं वत्से यथावद् ब्रूहि पृच्छते ॥
1.11.m: Himavat said: / Who are you, O goddess, large-eyed lady, marked by the crescent moon? / I do not know you, O child; tell me truly, as I ask.

1.11.s:
girīndravacanaṃ śrutvā tataḥ sā parameśvarī /
vyājahāra mahāśailaṃ yogināmabhayapradā //
1.11.d:
गिरीन्द्रवचनं श्रुत्वा ततः सा परमेश्वरी ।
व्याजहार महाशैलं योगिनामभयप्रदा ॥
1.11.m: Having heard the words of the lord of mountains, that supreme sovereign, / who grants fearlessness to yogins, then addressed the great mountain.

1.11.s:
devyuvāca
māṃ viddha paramāṃ śaktiṃ parameśvarasamāśrayām /
ananyāmavyayāmekāṃ yāṃ paśyanti mumukṣavaḥ //
1.11.d:
देव्युवाच
मां विद्ध परमां शक्तिं परमेश्वरसमाश्रयाम् ।
अनन्यामव्ययामेकां यां पश्यन्ति मुमुक्षवः ॥
1.11.m: The goddess said: / Know me as the supreme power resting on the supreme Lord, / non-different [from him], imperishable, one, whom seekers of liberation behold.

1.11.s:
ahaṃ vai sarvabhāvānātmā sarvāntarā śivā /
śāśvataiśvaryavijñānamūrtiḥ sarvapravartikā //
1.11.d:
अहं वै सर्वभावानात्मा सर्वान्तरा शिवा ।
शाश्वतैश्वर्यविज्ञानमूर्तिः सर्वप्रवर्तिका ॥
1.11.m: I indeed am the Self of all states of being, the innermost soul of all, the auspicious one; / the embodiment of knowledge and eternal sovereignty, the impeller of all.

1.11.s:
anantānantamahimā saṃsārārṇavatāriṇī /
divyaṃ dadāmi te cakṣuḥ paśya me rūpamaiśvaram //
1.11.d:
अनन्तानन्तमहिमा संसारार्णवतारिणी ।
दिव्यं ददामि ते चक्षुः पश्य मे रूपमैश्वरम् ॥
1.11.m: Endowed with infinite and endless majesty, carrying [beings] across the ocean of worldly existence; / I give you divine vision; behold my sovereign form!

1.11.s:
etāvaduktvā vijñānaṃ dattvā himavate svayam /
svaṃ rūpaṃ darśayāmāsa divyaṃ tat pārameśvaram //
1.11.d:
एतावदुक्त्वा विज्ञानं दत्त्वा हिमवते स्वयम् ।
स्वं रूपं दर्शयामास दिव्यं तत् पारमेश्वरम् ॥
1.11.m: Having said this and herself granted knowledge to Himavat, / she revealed her divine sovereign form.

1.11.s:
koṭisūryapritīkāśaṃ tejobimbaṃ nirākulam /
jvālāmālāsahastrāḍhyaṃ kālānalaśatopamam //
1.11.d:
कोटिसूर्यप्रितीकाशं तेजोबिम्बं निराकुलम् ।
ज्वालामालासहस्त्राढ्यं कालानलशतोपमम् ॥
1.11.m: Resembling ten million suns, an unperturbed orb of splendor, / rich in thousands of garlands of flames, equal to a hundred fires of cosmic destruction,

1.11.s:
daṃṣṭrākarālaṃ durdharṣa jaṭāmaṇḍalamaṇḍitam /
triśūlavarahastaṃ ca ghorarūpaṃ bhayānakam //
1.11.d:
दंष्ट्राकरालं दुर्धर्ष जटामण्डलमण्डितम् ।
त्रिशूलवरहस्तं च घोररूपं भयानकम् ॥
1.11.m: fierce with fangs, unassailable, adorned with a mass of matted locks, / holding a trident and bestowing boons with her hands, of terrifying and frightful form,

1.11.s:
praśāntaṃ saumyavadanamanantāścaryasaṃyutam /
candrāvayavalakṣmāṇaṃ candrakoṭisamaprabham //
1.11.d:
प्रशान्तं सौम्यवदनमनन्ताश्चर्यसंयुतम् ।
चन्द्रावयवलक्ष्माणं चन्द्रकोटिसमप्रभम् ॥
1.11.m: peaceful, with a serene countenance, joined with endless wonders, / having the crescent moon as her mark, equal in splendor to ten million moons,

1.11.s:
kirīṭinaṃ gadāhastaṃ nūpurairupaśobhitam /
divyamālyāmbaradharaṃ divyagandhānulepanam //
1.11.d:
किरीटिनं गदाहस्तं नूपुरैरुपशोभितम् ।
दिव्यमाल्याम्बरधरं दिव्यगन्धानुलेपनम् ॥
1.11.m: crowned with a diadem, with a mace in hand, adorned with anklets, / wearing divine garlands and garments, anointed with divine fragrant pastes,

1.11.s:
śaṅkhacakradharaṃ kāmyaṃ trinetraṃ kṛttivāsasam /
aṇḍasthaṃ cāṇḍabāhyasthaṃ bāhyamābhyantaraṃ param //
1.11.d:
शङ्खचक्रधरं काम्यं त्रिनेत्रं कृत्तिवाससम् ।
अण्डस्थं चाण्डबाह्यस्थं बाह्यमाभ्यन्तरं परम् ॥
1.11.m: holding a conch and a discus, desirable, three-eyed, clad in an animal hide, / residing inside the cosmic egg and outside the cosmic egg, exterior, interior, supreme,

1.11.s:
sarvaśaktimayaṃ śubhraṃ sarvākāraṃ sanātanam /
brahmondropendrayogīndrairvandyamānapadāmbujam //
1.11.d:
सर्वशक्तिमयं शुभ्रं सर्वाकारं सनातनम् ।
ब्रह्मोन्द्रोपेन्द्रयोगीन्द्रैर्वन्द्यमानपदाम्बुजम् ॥
1.11.m: consisting of all powers, radiant white, possessing all forms, eternal, / whose lotus-feet are praised by Brahmā, Indra, Upendra, and the lords of yogins,

1.11.s:
sarvataḥ pāṇipādāntaṃ sarvato 'kṣiśiromukham /
sarvamāvṛtya tiṣṭhantaṃ dadarśa parameśvaram //
1.11.d:
सर्वतः पाणिपादान्तं सर्वतो ऽक्षिशिरोमुखम् ।
सर्वमावृत्य तिष्ठन्तं ददर्श परमेश्वरम् ॥
1.11.m: with hands and feet on all sides, with eyes, heads, and faces on all sides, / standing pervading all—he beheld the supreme Lord.

1.11.s:
dṛṣṭvā tadīdṛśaṃ rūpaṃ devyā māheśvaraṃ param /
bhayena ca samāviṣṭaḥ sa rājā hṛṣṭamānasaḥ //
1.11.d:
दृष्ट्वा तदीदृशं रूपं देव्या माहेश्वरं परम् ।
भयेन च समाविष्टः स राजा हृष्टमानसः ॥
1.11.m: Seeing that supreme form of the goddess belonging to Maheśvara, / seized with awe and dread, that king, joyful in mind,

1.11.s:
ātmanyādhāya cātmānamoṅkāraṃ samanusmaran /
nāmnāmaṣṭasahastreṇa tuṣṭāva parameśvarīm //
1.11.d:
आत्मन्याधाय चात्मानमोङ्कारं समनुस्मरन् ।
नाम्नामष्टसहस्त्रेण तुष्टाव परमेश्वरीम् ॥
1.11.m: establishing the self in the Self, recollecting the syllable Om, / praised the supreme sovereign with the eight thousand names.

1.11.s:
hīmavānuvāca
śivomā paramā śaktiranantā niṣkalāmalā /
śāntā māheśvarī nityā śāśvatī paramākṣarā //
1.11.d:
हीमवानुवाच
शिवोमा परमा शक्तिरनन्ता निष्कलामला ।
शान्ता माहेश्वरी नित्या शाश्वती परमाक्षरा ॥
1.11.m: Himavat said: / Śivā, Umā, supreme power, infinite, without parts, stainless, / tranquil, belonging to Maheśvara, permanent, eternal, the supreme imperishable,

1.11.s:
acintyā kevalānantyā śivātmā paramātmikā /
anādiravyayā śuddhā devātmā sarvagācalā //
1.11.d:
अचिन्त्या केवलानन्त्या शिवात्मा परमात्मिका ।
अनादिरव्यया शुद्धा देवात्मा सर्वगाचला ॥
1.11.m: inconceivable, absolute infinity, whose self is Śiva, the supreme Self, / beginningless, undecaying, pure, divine Self, all-pervading, immovable,

1.11.s:
ekānekavibhāgasthā māyātītā sunirmalā /
mahāmāheśvarī satyā mahādevī nirañjanā //
1.11.d:
एकानेकविभागस्था मायातीता सुनिर्मला ।
महामाहेश्वरी सत्या महादेवी निरञ्जना ॥
1.11.m: dwelling in both the singular and the manifold division, beyond the illusory creative power, perfectly pure, / great consort of Maheśvara, truth, Great Goddess, stainless,

1.11.s:
kāṣṭhā sarvāntarasthā ca cicchaktiratilālasā /
nandā sarvātmikā vidyā jyotīrūpāmṛtākṣarā //
1.11.d:
काष्ठा सर्वान्तरस्था च चिच्छक्तिरतिलालसा ।
नन्दा सर्वात्मिका विद्या ज्योतीरूपामृताक्षरा ॥
1.11.m: the culmination, dwelling within all, the power of consciousness, intensely eager, / delightful, the Self of all, wisdom, having the form of light, immortal, imperishable,

1.11.s:
śāntiḥ pratiṣṭhā sarveṣāṃ nivṛttiramṛtapradā /
vyomamūrtirvyomalayā vyomādhārācyutāmarā //
1.11.d:
शान्तिः प्रतिष्ठा सर्वेषां निवृत्तिरमृतप्रदा ।
व्योममूर्तिर्व्योमलया व्योमाधाराच्युतामरा ॥
1.11.m: peace, foundation of all, cessation, granter of immortality, / whose form is space, dissolved in space, supported by space, infallible, immortal,

1.11.s:
anādinidhanāmoghā kāraṇātmā kalākalā /
kratuḥ prathamajā nābhiramṛtasyātmasaṃśrayā //
1.11.d:
अनादिनिधनामोघा कारणात्मा कलाकला ।
क्रतुः प्रथमजा नाभिरमृतस्यात्मसंश्रया ॥
1.11.m: without beginning or end, infallible, whose nature is the cause, composed of parts and beyond parts, / sacrifice, the first-born, the navel of immortality, resting in the Self,

1.11.s:
prāṇeśvarapriyā mātā mahāmahiṣaghātinī /
prāṇeśvarī prāṇarūpā pradhānapuruṣeśvarī //
1.11.d:
प्राणेश्वरप्रिया माता महामहिषघातिनी ।
प्राणेश्वरी प्राणरूपा प्रधानपुरुषेश्वरी ॥
1.11.m: beloved of the lord of life, mother, slayer of the great Mahiṣa, / sovereign of life, whose form is life, sovereign over primary matter and the spirit,

1.11.s:
sarvaśaktikalākārā jyotsnā dyormahimāspadā /
sarvakāryaniyantrī ca sarvabhūteśvareśvarī //
1.11.d:
सर्वशक्तिकलाकारा ज्योत्स्ना द्योर्महिमास्पदा ।
सर्वकार्यनियन्त्री च सर्वभूतेश्वरेश्वरी ॥
1.11.m: whose form consists of all parts of power, moonlight, the sky, the abode of greatness, / regulator of every effect, sovereign of the rulers of all creatures,

1.11.s:
anādiravyaktaguhā mahānandā sanātanī /
ākāśayoniryogasthā mahāyogeśvareśvarī //
1.11.d:
अनादिरव्यक्तगुहा महानन्दा सनातनी ।
आकाशयोनिर्योगस्था महायोगेश्वरेश्वरी ॥
1.11.m: beginningless, the unmanifest cave, supreme bliss, eternal, / the womb of space, established in yoga, sovereign of the lords of great yoga,

1.11.s:
mahāmāyā suduṣpūrā mūlaprakṛtirīśvarī /
saṃsārayoniḥ sakalā sarvaśaktisamudbhavā //
1.11.d:
महामाया सुदुष्पूरा मूलप्रकृतिरीश्वरी ।
संसारयोनिः सकला सर्वशक्तिसमुद्भवा ॥
1.11.m: the great illusory creative power, very hard to satisfy, root primordial matter, sovereign Lady, / the womb of worldly existence, possessing parts, the origin of all powers,

1.11.s:
saṃsārapārā durvārā durnirokṣyā durāsadā /
prāṇaśaktiḥ praṇavidyā yoginī paramā kalā //
1.11.d:
संसारपारा दुर्वारा दुर्निरोक्ष्या दुरासदा ।
प्राणशक्तिः प्रणविद्या योगिनी परमा कला ॥
1.11.m: the shore across worldly existence, irresistible, difficult to behold, hard to approach, / the vital power, the science of the life-breath, yoginī, the supreme part,

1.11.s:
mahāvibhūtirdurdharṣā mūlaprakṛtisaṃbhavā /
anādyanantavibhavā parārthā puruṣāraṇiḥ //
1.11.d:
महाविभूतिर्दुर्धर्षा मूलप्रकृतिसंभवा ।
अनाद्यनन्तविभवा परार्था पुरुषारणिः ॥
1.11.m: the great manifestation of power, unassailable, born from root primordial matter, / of beginningless and endless glory, whose aim is another, the fire-stick of the spirit,

1.11.s:
sargasthityantakaraṇī sudurvācyā duratyayā /
śabdayoniḥ śabdamayī nādākhyā nādavigrahā //
1.11.d:
सर्गस्थित्यन्तकरणी सुदुर्वाच्या दुरत्यया ।
शब्दयोनिः शब्दमयी नादाख्या नादविग्रहा ॥
1.11.m: the agent of creation, maintenance, and dissolution, very hard to express, difficult to cross, / the source of sound, consisting of sound, named sound, the embodiment of sound,

1.11.s:
pradhānapuruṣātītā pradhānapuruṣātmikā /
purāṇī cinmayī puṃsāmādiḥ puruṣarūpiṇī //
1.11.d:
प्रधानपुरुषातीता प्रधानपुरुषात्मिका ।
पुराणी चिन्मयी पुंसामादिः पुरुषरूपिणी ॥
1.11.m: beyond primary matter and the spirit, the essence of primary matter and the spirit, / ancient, made of consciousness, origin of men, possessing the form of the spirit.

1.11.s:
bhūtāntarātmā kūṭasthā mahāpuruṣasaṃjñitā /
janmamṛtyujarātītā sarvaśaktisamanvitā //
1.11.d:
भूतान्तरात्मा कूटस्था महापुरुषसंज्ञिता ।
जन्ममृत्युजरातीता सर्वशक्तिसमन्विता ॥
1.11.m:
She is the inner self of all beings, immovable, designated as the Great Spirit,
transcending birth, death, and old age, endowed with all powers.

1.11.s:
vyāpinī cānavacchinnā pradhānānupraveśinī /
kṣetrajñaśaktiravyaktalakṣaṇā malavarjitā //
1.11.d:
व्यापिनी चानवच्छिन्ना प्रधानानुप्रवेशिनी ।
क्षेत्रज्ञशक्तिरव्यक्तलक्षणा मलवर्जिता ॥
1.11.m:
All-pervading and uncircumscribed, entering into primordial matter,
she is the power of the knower of the field, characterised by the unmanifest, free from impurity.

1.11.s:
anādimāyasaṃbhinnā tritattvā prakṛtirguhā /
mahāmāyāsamutpannā tāmasī pauruṣī dhruvā //
1.11.d:
अनादिमायसंभिन्ना त्रितत्त्वा प्रकृतिर्गुहा ।
महामायासमुत्पन्ना तामसी पौरुषी ध्रुवा ॥
1.11.m:
Interwoven with beginningless illusory creative power, possessing the three principles, she is primordial matter, hidden,
arisen from the great illusory creative power, consisting of darkness, belonging to the spirit, steadfast.

1.11.s:
vyaktāvyaktātmikākṛṣṇā raktāśuklā prasūtikā /
akāryā kāryajananī nityaṃ prasavadharmiṇī //
1.11.d:
व्यक्ताव्यक्तात्मिकाकृष्णा रक्ताशुक्ला प्रसूतिका ।
अकार्या कार्यजननी नित्यं प्रसवधर्मिणी ॥
1.11.m:
Embodying both the manifest and the unmanifest, black, red, and white, the procreatress,
free from effects, the producer of effects, having the eternal nature of giving birth.

1.11.s:
sargapralayanirmuktā sṛṣṭisthityantadharmiṇī /
brahmagarbhā caturviśā padmanābhācyutātmikā //
1.11.d:
सर्गप्रलयनिर्मुक्ता सृष्टिस्थित्यन्तधर्मिणी ।
ब्रह्मगर्भा चतुर्विशा पद्मनाभाच्युतात्मिका ॥
1.11.m:
Released from primary creation and dissolution, possessing the qualities of creation, maintenance, and destruction,
carrying Brahmā in her womb, the twenty-fourth [principle], identical with Padmanābha and Acyuta.

1.11.s:
vaidyutī śāśvatī yonirjaganmāteśvarapriyā /
sarvādhārā mahārūpā sarvaiśvaryasamanvitā //
1.11.d:
वैद्युती शाश्वती योनिर्जगन्मातेश्वरप्रिया ।
सर्वाधारा महारूपा सर्वैश्वर्यसमन्विता ॥
1.11.m:
Consisting of lightning, the eternal source, the mother of the universe, beloved of the Lord,
the support of all, possessing a great form, endowed with all sovereignty.

1.11.s:
viśvarūpā mahāgarbhā viśveśecchānuvartinī /
mahīyasī brahmayonirmahālakṣmīsamudbhāvā //
1.11.d:
विश्वरूपा महागर्भा विश्वेशेच्छानुवर्तिनी ।
महीयसी ब्रह्मयोनिर्महालक्ष्मीसमुद्भावा ॥
1.11.m:
Possessing universal form, having a vast womb, conforming to the will of the Lord of the Universe,
most exalted, the womb of Brahman, originating as Mahālakṣmī.

1.11.s:
mahāvimānamadhyasthā mahānidrātmahetukā /
sarvasādhāraṇī sūkṣmā hyavidyā pāramārthikā //
1.11.d:
महाविमानमध्यस्था महानिद्रात्महेतुका ।
सर्वसाधारणी सूक्ष्मा ह्यविद्या पारमार्थिका ॥
1.11.m:
Situated in the midst of the great celestial chariot, having the great slumber as her cause,
common to all, subtle, indeed the ultimate nescience.

1.11.s:
anantarūpānantasthā devī puruṣamohinī /
anekākārasaṃsthānā kālatrayavivarjitā //
1.11.d:
अनन्तरूपानन्तस्था देवी पुरुषमोहिनी ।
अनेकाकारसंस्थाना कालत्रयविवर्जिता ॥
1.11.m:
Having infinite forms, abiding in infinity, the goddess bewildering the spirit,
existing in manifold shapes, devoid of the three divisions of time.

1.11.s:
brahmajanmā harermūrtirbrahmaviṣṇuśivātmikā /
brahmeśaviṣṇujananī brahmākhyā brahmasaṃśrayā //
1.11.d:
ब्रह्मजन्मा हरेर्मूर्तिर्ब्रह्मविष्णुशिवात्मिका ।
ब्रह्मेशविष्णुजननी ब्रह्माख्या ब्रह्मसंश्रया ॥
1.11.m:
Born of Brahman, the embodiment of Hari, composed of Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Śiva,
the mother of Brahmā, the Lord, and Viṣṇu, called Brahman, taking refuge in Brahman.

1.11.s:
vyaktā prathamajā brāhmī mahatī jñānarūpiṇī /
vairāgyaiśvaryadharmātmā brahmamūrtirhṛdisthitā /
apāṃyoniḥ svayaṃbhūtirmānasī tattvasaṃbhavā //
1.11.d:
व्यक्ता प्रथमजा ब्राह्मी महती ज्ञानरूपिणी ।
वैराग्यैश्वर्यधर्मात्मा ब्रह्ममूर्तिर्हृदिस्थिता ।
अपांयोनिः स्वयंभूतिर्मानसी तत्त्वसंभवा ॥
1.11.m:
Manifest, the firstborn, Brāhmī, the Great One, consisting of knowledge,
whose nature is dispassion, sovereignty, and righteousness, the embodiment of Brahman dwelling in the heart,
the source of the waters, self-existent, mental, arisen from the principles.

1.11.s:
īśvarāṇī ca śarvāṇī śaṅkarārdhaśarīriṇī /
bhavānī caiva rudrāṇī mahālakṣmīrathāmbikā //
1.11.d:
ईश्वराणी च शर्वाणी शङ्करार्धशरीरिणी ।
भवानी चैव रुद्राणी महालक्ष्मीरथाम्बिका ॥
1.11.m:
She is Īśvarāṇī and Śarvāṇī, forming half of Śaṅkara’s body,
and Bhavānī, Rudrāṇī, Mahālakṣmī, and Ambikā.

1.11.s:
maheśvarasamutpannā bhuktimuktiphalapradā /
sarveśvarī sarvavandyā nityaṃ muditamānasā //
1.11.d:
महेश्वरसमुत्पन्ना भुक्तिमुक्तिफलप्रदा ।
सर्वेश्वरी सर्ववन्द्या नित्यं मुदितमानसा ॥
1.11.m:
Arisen from the Great Lord, granting the fruits of enjoyment and liberation,
sovereign of all, adored by all, ever joyful in mind.

1.11.s:
brahmendropendranamitā śaṅkarecchānuvartinī /
īśvarārdhāsanagatā maheśvarapativratā //
1.11.d:
ब्रह्मेन्द्रोपेन्द्रनमिता शङ्करेच्छानुवर्तिनी ।
ईश्वरार्धासनगता महेश्वरपतिव्रता ॥
1.11.m:
Bowed to by Brahmā, Indra, and Upendra, conforming to Śaṅkara’s will,
seated on half of the Lord’s seat, devoted as a faithful wife to the Great Lord.

1.11.s:
sakṛdvibhāvitā sarvā samudrapariśoṣiṇī /
pārvatī himavatputrī paramānandadāyinī //
1.11.d:
सकृद्विभाविता सर्वा समुद्रपरिशोषिणी ।
पार्वती हिमवत्पुत्री परमानन्ददायिनी ॥
1.11.m:
Conceived at once as everything, drying up the ocean,
Pārvatī, daughter of the Himavat, bestowing supreme bliss.

1.11.s:
guṇāḍhyā yogajā yogyā jñānamūrtirvikāsinī /
sāvitrīkamalā lakṣmīḥ śrīranantorasi sthitā //
1.11.d:
गुणाढ्या योगजा योग्या ज्ञानमूर्तिर्विकासिनी ।
सावित्रीकमला लक्ष्मीः श्रीरनन्तोरसि स्थिता ॥
1.11.m:
Abounding in virtues, born of yoga, fitting, the embodiment of knowledge, blossoming,
Sāvitrī, Kamalā, Lakṣmī, Śrī resting on the chest of Ananta.

1.11.s:
sarojanilayā mudrā yoganidrā surārdinā /
sarasvatī sarvavidyā jagajjyeṣṭhā sumaṅgalā //
1.11.d:
सरोजनिलया मुद्रा योगनिद्रा सुरार्दिना ।
सरस्वती सर्वविद्या जगज्ज्येष्ठा सुमङ्गला ॥
1.11.m:
Dwelling in a lotus, the mystic seal, the slumber of yoga, destroying the demons,
Sarasvatī, all knowledge, the eldest in the universe, most auspicious.

1.11.s:
vāgdevī varadā vācyā kīrtiḥ sarvārthasādhikā /
yogīśvarī brahmavidyā mahāvidyā suśobhanā //
1.11.d:
वाग्देवी वरदा वाच्या कीर्तिः सर्वार्थसाधिका ।
योगीश्वरी ब्रह्मविद्या महाविद्या सुशोभना ॥
1.11.m:
Goddess of speech, bestower of boons, expressed by words, fame, achieving all aims,
mistress of yogins, knowledge of Brahman, the great knowledge, splendid.

1.11.s:
guhyavidyātmavidyā ca dharmavidyātmabhāvitā /
svāhā viśvaṃbharā siddhiḥ svadhā medhā dhṛtiḥ śrutiḥ //
1.11.d:
गुह्यविद्यात्मविद्या च धर्मविद्यात्मभाविता ।
स्वाहा विश्वंभरा सिद्धिः स्वधा मेधा धृतिः श्रुतिः ॥
1.11.m:
Secret knowledge, knowledge of the self, knowledge of righteousness, meditating on the self,
Svāhā, the all-bearer, perfection, Svadhā, intellect, fortitude, Vedic revelation.

1.11.s:
nītiḥ sunītiḥ sukṛtirmādhavī naravāhinī /
ajā vibhāvarī saumyā bhoginī bhogadāyinī //
1.11.d:
नीतिः सुनीतिः सुकृतिर्माधवी नरवाहिनी ।
अजा विभावरी सौम्या भोगिनी भोगदायिनी ॥
1.11.m:
Policy, right conduct, virtue, Mādhavī, borne by men,
unborn, the night, gentle, enjoying, bestowing enjoyment.

1.11.s:
śobhā vaṃśakarī lolā mālinī parameṣṭhinī /
trailokyasundarī ramyā sundarī kāmacāriṇī //
1.11.d:
शोभा वंशकरी लोला मालिनी परमेष्ठिनी ।
त्रैलोक्यसुन्दरी रम्या सुन्दरी कामचारिणी ॥
1.11.m:
Splendour, propagating lineage, trembling, garlanded, the supreme mistress,
the beauty of the three worlds, delightful, charming, moving at will.

1.11.s:
mahānubhāvā sattvasthā mahāmahiṣamardanī /
padmamālā pāpaharā vicitrā mukuṭānanā //
1.11.d:
महानुभावा सत्त्वस्था महामहिषमर्दनी ।
पद्ममाला पापहरा विचित्रा मुकुटानना ॥
1.11.m:
Of great majesty, abiding in purity, crusher of the great Mahiṣa,
wearing a lotus garland, dispelling sin, manifold, crowned.

1.11.s:
niryantrā yantravāhasthā nandinī bhadrakālikā /
ādityavarṇā kaumārī mayūravaravāhinī //
1.11.d:
निर्यन्त्रा यन्त्रवाहस्था नन्दिनी भद्रकालिका ।
आदित्यवर्णा कौमारी मयूरवरवाहिनी ॥
1.11.m:
Unrestrained, mounted on a mechanistic chariot, Nandinī, Bhadrakālikā,
sun-coloured, Kaumārī, riding an excellent peacock.

1.11.s:
niryantrā yantravāhasthā nandinī bhadrakālikā /
ādityavarṇā kaumārī mayūravaravāhinī //
1.11.d:
निर्यन्त्रा यन्त्रवाहस्था नन्दिनी भद्रकालिका ।
आदित्यवर्णा कौमारी मयूरवरवाहिनी ॥
1.11.m:
Unrestrained, mounted on a mechanistic chariot, Nandinī, Bhadrakālikā,
sun-coloured, Kaumārī, riding an excellent peacock.

1.11.s:
vṛṣāsanagatā gauro mahākālī surārcitā /
aditirniyatā raudrī padmagarbhā vivāhanā //
1.11.d:
वृषासनगता गौरो महाकाली सुरार्चिता ।
अदितिर्नियता रौद्री पद्मगर्भा विवाहना ॥
1.11.m:
Mounted on a bull, fair, Mahākālī, worshipped by the gods,
Aditi, restrained, fierce, holding a lotus in her womb, without a mount.

1.11.s:
virūpākṣī lelihānā mahāpuranivāsinī /
mahāphalānavadyāṅgī kāmapūrā vibhāvarī //
1.11.d:
विरूपाक्षी लेलिहाना महापुरनिवासिनी ।
महाफलानवद्याङ्गी कामपूरा विभावरी ॥
1.11.m:
Diversely eyed, darting her tongue, dwelling in the great city,
yielding great fruit, faultless-limbed, fulfilling desire, the night.

1.11.s:
vicitraratnamukuṭā praṇatārtiprabhañjanī /
kauśikī karṣaṇī rātristridaśārtivināśinī //
1.11.d:
विचित्ररत्नमुकुटा प्रणतार्तिप्रभञ्जनी ।
कौशिकी कर्षणी रात्रिस्त्रिदशार्तिविनाशिनी ॥
1.11.m:
Wearing a crown of varied gems, crushing the affliction of the humble,
Kauśikī, Karṣaṇī, the night, destroyer of the gods’ distress.

1.11.s:
bahurūpā surūpā ca virūpā rūpavarjitā /
bhaktārtiśamanī bhavyā bhavabhāvavināśanī //
1.11.d:
बहुरूपा सुरूपा च विरूपा रूपवर्जिता ।
भक्तार्तिशमनी भव्या भवभावविनाशनी ॥
1.11.m:
Multiform, shapely, deformed, devoid of form,
calming the distress of devotees, auspicious, destroying worldly existence.

1.11.s:
nirguṇā nityavibhavā niḥ sārā nirapatrapā /
yaśasvinī sāmagītirbhavāṅganilayālayā //
1.11.d:
निर्गुणा नित्यविभवा निः सारा निरपत्रपा ।
यशस्विनी सामगीतिर्भवाङ्गनिलयालया ॥
1.11.m:
Devoid of qualities, having eternal glory, insubstantial, shameless,
renowned, sung in the Sāman hymns, dwelling in Śiva’s body.

1.11.s:
dīkṣā vidyādharī dīptā mahendravinipātinī /
sarvātiśāyinī vidyā sarvasiddhipradāyinī //
1.11.d:
दीक्षा विद्याधरी दीप्ता महेन्द्रविनिपातिनी ।
सर्वातिशायिनी विद्या सर्वसिद्धिप्रदायिनी ॥
1.11.m:
Initiation, Vidyādharī, radiant, striking down great Indra,
surpassing all, knowledge, granter of all perfections.

1.11.s:
sarveśvarapriyā tārkṣyā samudrāntaravāsinī /
akalaṅkā nirādhārā nityasiddhā nirāmayā //
1.11.d:
सर्वेश्वरप्रिया तार्क्ष्या समुद्रान्तरवासिनी ।
अकलङ्का निराधारा नित्यसिद्धा निरामया ॥
1.11.m:
Beloved of the Lord of all, belonging to Garuḍa, dwelling in the ocean,
spotless, groundless, ever-perfect, free from disease.

1.11.s:
kāmadhenurbṛhadgarbhā dhīmatī mohanāśinī /
niḥ saṅkalpā nirātaṅkā vinayā vinayapradā //
1.11.d:
कामधेनुर्बृहद्गर्भा धीमती मोहनाशिनी ।
निः सङ्कल्पा निरातङ्का विनया विनयप्रदा ॥
1.11.m:
The wish-granting cow, of vast womb, wise, dispelling delusion,
free from conception, free from fear, humility, bestowing humility.

1.11.s:
jvālāmālāsahastrāḍhyā devadevī manonmanī /
mahābhagavatī durgā vāsudevasamudbhavā //
1.11.d:
ज्वालामालासहस्त्राढ्या देवदेवी मनोन्मनी ।
महाभगवती दुर्गा वासुदेवसमुद्भवा ॥
1.11.m:
Rich with thousands of flame-garlands, goddess of gods, lifting up the mind,
the great goddess, Durgā, originated from Vāsudeva.

1.11.s:
mahendropendrabhaginī bhaktigamyā parāvarā /
jñānajñeyā jarātītā vedāntaviṣayā gatiḥ //
1.11.d:
महेन्द्रोपेन्द्रभगिनी भक्तिगम्या परावरा ।
ज्ञानज्ञेया जरातीता वेदान्तविषया गतिः ॥
1.11.m:
Sister of great Indra and Upendra, attainable by devotion, higher and lower,
to be known through knowledge, beyond old age, the goal forming the subject of the Vedānta.

1.11.s:
dakṣiṇā dahanā dāhyā sarvabhūtanamaskṛtā /
yogamāyā vibhāvajñā mahāmāyā mahīyasī //
1.11.d:
दक्षिणा दहना दाह्या सर्वभूतनमस्कृता ।
योगमाया विभावज्ञा महामाया महीयसी ॥
1.11.m:
The sacrificial gift, burning, combustible, saluted by all beings,
the illusory power of yoga, knowing distinction, the great illusory creative power, most exalted.

1.11.s:
saṃdhyā sarvasamudbhūtirbrahmavṛkṣāśrayānatiḥ /
bījāṅkurasamudbhūtirmahāśaktirmahāmatiḥ //
1.11.d:
संध्या सर्वसमुद्भूतिर्ब्रह्मवृक्षाश्रयानतिः ।
बीजाङ्कुरसमुद्भूतिर्महाशक्तिर्महामतिः ॥
1.11.m:
Twilight, the origin of all, the resting-place of the tree of Brahman, adoration,
the arising of seed and sprout, the great power, the great mind.

1.11.s:
khyātiḥ prajñā citiḥ saṃvit mahābhogīndraśāyinī /
vikṛtiḥ śāṃsarī śāstrī gaṇagandharvasevitā //
1.11.d:
ख्यातिः प्रज्ञा चितिः संवित् महाभोगीन्द्रशायिनी ।
विकृतिः शांसरी शास्त्री गणगन्धर्वसेविता ॥
1.11.m:
Renown, insight, consciousness, understanding, reclining on the great king of serpents,
modification, wandering, ruler, served by the Gaṇas and Gandharvas.

1.11.s:
vaiśvānarī mahāśālā devasenā guhapriyā /
mahārātriḥ śivānandā śacī duḥ svapnanāśinī //
1.11.d:
वैश्वानरी महाशाला देवसेना गुहप्रिया ।
महारात्रिः शिवानन्दा शची दुः स्वप्ननाशिनी ॥
1.11.m:
Belonging to fire, the great hall, Devasenā, beloved of Guha,
the Great Night, the bliss of Śiva, Śacī, destroyer of bad dreams.

1.11.s:
ijyā pūjyā jagaddhātrī durvijñeyā surūpiṇī /
guhāmbikā guṇotpattirmahāpīṭhā marutsutā //
1.11.d:
इज्या पूज्या जगद्धात्री दुर्विज्ञेया सुरूपिणी ।
गुहाम्बिका गुणोत्पत्तिर्महापीठा मरुत्सुता ॥
1.11.m:
Sacrifice, worthy of worship, supporter of the world, hard to know, beautifully formed,
Ambikā in the cave, the source of qualities, the great sacred seat, daughter of the wind.

1.11.s:
havyavāhāntarāgādiḥ havyavāhasamudbhavā /
jagadyonirjaganmātā janmamṛtyujarātigā //
1.11.d:
हव्यवाहान्तरागादिः हव्यवाहसमुद्भवा ।
जगद्योनिर्जगन्माता जन्ममृत्युजरातिगा ॥
1.11.m:
The beginning within the fire, born of the fire,
source of the universe, mother of the universe, transcending birth, death, and old age.

1.11.s:
buddhimātā buddhimatī puruṣāntaravāsinī /
tarasvinī samādhisthā trinetrā divisaṃsthitā //
1.11.d:
बुद्धिमाता बुद्धिमती पुरुषान्तरवासिनी ।
तरस्विनी समाधिस्था त्रिनेत्रा दिविसंस्थिता ॥
1.11.m:
Mother of intellect, possessing intellect, dwelling within the spirit,
swift, absorbed in meditation, three-eyed, dwelling in heaven.

1.11.s:
sarvendriyamanomātā sarvabhūtahṛdi sthitā /
saṃsāratāriṇī vidyā brahmavādimanolayā //
1.11.d:
सर्वेन्द्रियमनोमाता सर्वभूतहृदि स्थिता ।
संसारतारिणी विद्या ब्रह्मवादिमनोलया ॥
1.11.m:
Mother of all senses and mind, dwelling in the hearts of all beings,
ferrying across worldly existence, knowledge, absorption of the mind of those who speak of Brahman.

1.11.s:
brahmāṇī bṛhatī brāhmī brahmabhūtā bhavāraṇiḥ /
hiraṇmayī mahārātriḥ saṃsāraparivartikā //
1.11.d:
ब्रह्माणी बृहती ब्राह्मी ब्रह्मभूता भवारणिः ।
हिरण्मयी महारात्रिः संसारपरिवर्तिका ॥
1.11.m:
Brahmāṇī, the vast, Brāhmī, absorbed in Brahman, the churning-stick of existence,
golden, the Great Night, turning the wheel of worldly existence.

1.11.s:
sumālinī surūpā ca bhāvinī tāriṇī prabhā /
unmīlanī sarvasahā sarvapratyayasākṣiṇī //
1.11.d:
सुमालिनी सुरूपा च भाविनी तारिणी प्रभा ।
उन्मीलनी सर्वसहा सर्वप्रत्ययसाक्षिणी ॥
1.11.m:
Well-garlanded, beautiful in form, becoming, carrying across, radiance,
opening the eyes, all-enduring, witness of all cognitions.

1.11.s:
susaumyā candravadanā tāṇḍavāsaktamānasā /
sattvaśuddhikarī śuddhirmalatrayavināśinī //
1.11.d:
सुसौम्या चन्द्रवदना ताण्डवासक्तमानसा ।
सत्त्वशुद्धिकरी शुद्धिर्मलत्रयविनाशिनी ॥
1.11.m:
Very gentle, moon-faced, her mind devoted to the dance of destruction,
producer of pure being, purity, destroyer of the three taints.

1.11.s:
jagatpriyā jaganmūrtistrimūrtiramṛtāśrayā /
nirāśrayā nirāhārā niraṅkuravanodbhavā //
1.11.d:
जगत्प्रिया जगन्मूर्तिस्त्रिमूर्तिरमृताश्रया ।
निराश्रया निराहारा निरङ्कुरवनोद्भवा ॥
1.11.m:
Dear to the universe, embodying the universe, threefold in form, resting on immortality,
supportless, feeding on nothing, born in a sproutless forest.

1.11.s:
candrahastā vicitrāṅgī stragviṇī padmadhāriṇī /
parāvaravidhānajñā mahāpuruṣapūrvajā //
1.11.d:
चन्द्रहस्ता विचित्राङ्गी स्त्रग्विणी पद्मधारिणी ।
परावरविधानज्ञा महापुरुषपूर्वजा ॥
1.11.m:
Holding the moon in her hand, having variegated limbs, wearing a garland, holding a lotus,
knowing the ordinances of the higher and lower, born before the Great Spirit.

1.11.s:
vidyeśvarapriyā vidyā vidyujjihvā jitaśramā /
vidyāmayī sahastrākṣī sahastravadanātmajā //
1.11.d:
विद्येश्वरप्रिया विद्या विद्युज्जिह्वा जितश्रमा ।
विद्यामयी सहस्त्राक्षी सहस्त्रवदनात्मजा ॥
1.11.m:
Beloved of the lord of knowledge, knowledge, lightning-tongued, having overcome fatigue,
composed of knowledge, thousand-eyed, daughter of the thousand-faced one.

1.11.s:
sahastraraśmiḥ sattvasthā maheśvarapadāśrayā /
kṣālinī sanmayī vyāptā taijasī padmabodhikā //
1.11.d:
सहस्त्ररश्मिः सत्त्वस्था महेश्वरपदाश्रया ।
क्षालिनी सन्मयी व्याप्ता तैजसी पद्मबोधिका ॥
1.11.m:
Thousand-rayed, abiding in pure being, taking refuge in the state of the Great Lord,
cleansing, consisting of true reality, pervading, fiery, causing the lotus to awaken.

1.11.s:
mahāmāyāśrayā mānyā mahādevamanoramā /
vyomalakṣmīḥ siharathā cekitānāmitaprabhā //
1.11.d:
महामायाश्रया मान्या महादेवमनोरमा ।
व्योमलक्ष्मीः सिहरथा चेकितानामितप्रभा ॥
1.11.m:
Abode of the great illusory creative power, venerable, delightful to Mahādeva,
fortune of the sky, riding a lion chariot, intelligent, of immeasurable radiance.

1.11.s:
vīreśvarī vimānasthā viśokāśokanāśinī /
anāhatā kuṇḍalinā nalinī padmavāsinī //
1.11.d:
वीरेश्वरी विमानस्था विशोकाशोकनाशिनी ।
अनाहता कुण्डलिना नलिनी पद्मवासिनी ॥
1.11.m:
Sovereign of heroes, riding a celestial chariot, sorrowless, destroyer of sorrow,
unbeaten, coiled as the kuṇḍalinī, a lotus, dwelling in a lotus.

1.11.s:
sadānandā sadākīrtiḥ sarvabhūtāśrayasthitā /
vāgdevatā brahmakalā kalātītā kalāraṇiḥ //
1.11.d:
सदानन्दा सदाकीर्तिः सर्वभूताश्रयस्थिता ।
वाग्देवता ब्रह्मकला कलातीता कलारणिः ॥
1.11.m: She is eternal bliss, eternal fame, abiding as the refuge of all beings, / the goddess of speech, the digit of Brahman, beyond all parts, the kindling-stick for the digits of arts.

1.11.s:
brahmaśrīrbrahmahṛdayā brahmaviṣṇuśivapriyā /
vyomaśaktiḥ kriyāśaktirjñānaśaktiḥ parāgatiḥ //
1.11.d:
ब्रह्मश्रीर्ब्रह्महृदया ब्रह्मविष्णुशिवप्रिया ।
व्योमशक्तिः क्रियाशक्तिर्ज्ञानशक्तिः परागतिः ॥
1.11.m: She is the splendor of Brahman, the heart of Brahman, dear to Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Śiva, / the power of space, the power of action, the power of knowledge, the supreme goal.

1.11.s:
kṣobhikā bandhikā bhedyā bhedābhedavivarjitā /
abhinnābhinnasaṃsthānā vaṃśinī vaṃśahāriṇī //
1.11.d:
क्षोभिका बन्धिका भेद्या भेदाभेदविवर्जिता ।
अभिन्नाभिन्नसंस्थाना वंशिनी वंशहारिणी ॥
1.11.m: She agitates, she binds, she is differentiated, yet free from difference and non-difference; / she is undivided, abiding as unbroken form, holding a lineage, and destroyer of lineage.

1.11.s:
guhyaśaktirguṇātītā sarvadā sarvatomukhī /
bhaginī bhagavatpatnī sakalā kālakāriṇī //
1.11.d:
गुह्यशक्तिर्गुणातीता सर्वदा सर्वतोमुखी ।
भगिनी भगवत्पत्नी सकला कालकारिणी ॥
1.11.m: She is the secret power, transcending the qualities, ever-present, facing in all directions, / the sister, the Lord's wife, complete in all parts, the maker of time.

1.11.s:
sarvavit sarvatobhadrā guhyātītā guhāraṇiḥ /
prakriyā yogamātā ca gaṅgā viśveśvareśvarī //
1.11.d:
सर्ववित् सर्वतोभद्रा गुह्यातीता गुहारणिः ।
प्रक्रिया योगमाता च गङ्गा विश्वेश्वरेश्वरी ॥
1.11.m: All-knowing, auspicious on every side, beyond the secret, the fire-drill of secrets, / cosmic process, the mother of yoga, the Gaṅgā, the sovereign over the lord of the universe.

1.11.s:
kapilā kāpilā kāntākanakābhākalāntarā /
puṇyā puṣkariṇī bhoktrī purandarapurassarā //
1.11.d:
कपिला कापिला कान्ताकनकाभाकलान्तरा ।
पुण्या पुष्करिणी भोक्त्री पुरन्दरपुरस्सरा ॥
1.11.m: She is Kapilā, related to Kapila, lovely, golden-hued, inner essence of all arts, / holy, a sacred lotus pond, the enjoyer, preceded by Indra.

1.11.s:
poṣaṇī paramaiśvaryabhūtidā bhūtibhūṣaṇā /
pañcabrahmasamutpattiḥ paramārthārthavigrahā //
1.11.d:
पोषणी परमैश्वर्यभूतिदा भूतिभूषणा ।
पञ्चब्रह्मसमुत्पत्तिः परमार्थार्थविग्रहा ॥
1.11.m: She is the nourisher, bestowing the glory of supreme sovereignty, adorned with sacred ashes, / the source of the five Brahmans, having the supreme reality as her form.

1.11.s:
dharmodayā bhānumatī yogijñeya manojavā /
manoharā manorakṣā tāpasī vedarūpiṇī //
1.11.d:
धर्मोदया भानुमती योगिज्ञेय मनोजवा ।
मनोहरा मनोरक्षा तापसी वेदरूपिणी ॥
1.11.m: The dawning of righteousness, radiant, knowable by yogins, swift as thought, / captivating, guardian of the mind, ascetic, having the form of the Veda.

1.11.s:
vedaśaktirvedamātā vedavidyāprakāśinī /
yogeśvareśvarī mātā mahāśaktirmanomayī //
1.11.d:
वेदशक्तिर्वेदमाता वेदविद्याप्रकाशिनी ।
योगेश्वरेश्वरी माता महाशक्तिर्मनोमयी ॥
1.11.m: The power of the Veda, mother of the Veda, revealer of Vedic wisdom, / sovereign mistress of the lords of yoga, the mother, the great power, composed of mind.

1.11.s:
viśvāvasthā viyanmūrtirvidyunmālā vihāyasī /
kiṃnarī surabhī vandyā nandinī nandivallabhā //
1.11.d:
विश्वावस्था वियन्मूर्तिर्विद्युन्माला विहायसी ।
किंनरी सुरभी वन्द्या नन्दिनी नन्दिवल्लभा ॥
1.11.m: The cosmic state, whose form is the ether, a garland of lightning, moving in the sky, / a Kiṃnarī, Surabhī, worthy of praise, delightful, beloved of Nandin.

1.11.s:
bhāratī paramānandā parāparavibhedikā /
sarvapraharaṇopetā kāmyā kāmeśvareśvarī //
1.11.d:
भारती परमानन्दा परापरविभेदिका ।
सर्वप्रहरणोपेता काम्या कामेश्वरेश्वरी ॥
1.11.m: Bhāratī, supreme bliss, discerning the higher and the lower, / equipped with every weapon, desirable, sovereign of the lord of desire.

1.11.s:
acintyācintyavibhavā hṛllekhā kanakaprabhā /
kūṣmāṇḍī dhanaratnāḍhyā sugandhā gandhāyinī //
1.11.d:
अचिन्त्याचिन्त्यविभवा हृल्लेखा कनकप्रभा ।
कूष्माण्डी धनरत्नाढ्या सुगन्धा गन्धायिनी ॥
1.11.m: Inconceivable, of inconceivable majesty, the heart's mystic syllable, golden-gleaming, / Kūṣmāṇḍī, rich in wealth and gems, fragrant, diffusing sweet scent.

1.11.s:
trivikramapadodbhūtā dhanuṣpāṇiḥ śivodayā /
sudurlabhā dhanādyakṣā dhanyā piṅgalalocanā //
1.11.d:
त्रिविक्रमपदोद्भूता धनुष्पाणिः शिवोदया ।
सुदुर्लभा धनाद्यक्षा धन्या पिङ्गललोचना ॥
1.11.m: Born from the footstep of Trivikrama, bow in hand, the dawning of auspiciousness, / very difficult to attain, overseer of wealth, blessed, amber-eyed.

1.11.s:
śāntiḥ prabhāvatī dīptiḥ paṅkajāyatalocanā /
ādyā hṛtkamalodbhūtā gavāṃ matā raṇapriyā //
1.11.d:
शान्तिः प्रभावती दीप्तिः पङ्कजायतलोचना ।
आद्या हृत्कमलोद्भूता गवां मता रणप्रिया ॥
1.11.m: Peace, full of radiance, splendor, large-eyed like a lotus, / the primordial one, arisen from the heart lotus, honored by cattle, lover of battle.

1.11.s:
satkriyā girijā śuddhā nityapuṣṭā nirantarā /
durgākātyāyanīcaṇḍī carcikā śāntavigrahā //
1.11.d:
सत्क्रिया गिरिजा शुद्धा नित्यपुष्टा निरन्तरा ।
दुर्गाकात्यायनीचण्डी चर्चिका शान्तविग्रहा ॥
1.11.m: Good deed, the daughter of the mountain, pure, ever well-nourished, unbroken, / Durgā, Kātyāyanī, Caṇḍī, Carcikā, of peaceful form.

1.11.s:
hiraṇyavarṇā rajanī jagadyantrapravartikā /
mandarādrinivāsā ca śāradā svarṇamālinī //
1.11.d:
हिरण्यवर्णा रजनी जगद्यन्त्रप्रवर्तिका ।
मन्दराद्रिनिवासा च शारदा स्वर्णमालिनी ॥
1.11.m: Golden-complexioned, the night, setting in motion the wheel of the universe, / dwelling on Mount Mandara, Śāradā, garlanded with gold.

1.11.s:
ratnamālā ratnagarbhā pṛthvī viśvapramāthinī /
padmānanā padmanibhā nityatuṣṭāmṛtodbhavā //
1.11.d:
रत्नमाला रत्नगर्भा पृथ्वी विश्वप्रमाथिनी ।
पद्मानना पद्मनिभा नित्यतुष्टामृतोद्भवा ॥
1.11.m: Garlanded with gems, having gems within her womb, the earth, crusher of the universe, / lotus-faced, lotus-like, ever-content, born from nectar.

1.11.s:
dhunvatī duḥ prakampyā ca sūryamātā dṛṣadvatī /
mahendrabhaginī mānyā vareṇyā varadarpitā //
1.11.d:
धुन्वती दुः प्रकम्प्या च सूर्यमाता दृषद्वती ।
महेन्द्रभगिनी मान्या वरेण्या वरदर्पिता ॥
1.11.m: Agitating, difficult to shake, mother of the sun, Dṛṣadvatī, / sister of Mahendra, venerable, to be chosen, proud of her boons.

1.11.s:
kalyāṇī kamalā rāmā pañcabhūtā varapradā /
vācyā vareśvarī vandyā durjayā duratikramā //
1.11.d:
कल्याणी कमला रामा पञ्चभूता वरप्रदा ।
वाच्या वरेश्वरी वन्द्या दुर्जया दुरतिक्रमा ॥
1.11.m: Auspicious, Kamalā, charming, the five gross elements, bestower of boons, / worthy to be proclaimed, sovereign over the foremost, adorable, invincible, insurmountable.

1.11.s:
kālarātrirmahāvegā vīrabhadrapriyā hitā /
bhadrakālī jaganmātā bhaktānāṃ bhadradāyinī //
1.11.d:
कालरात्रिर्महावेगा वीरभद्रप्रिया हिता ।
भद्रकाली जगन्माता भक्तानां भद्रदायिनी ॥
1.11.m: Kālarātri, of immense velocity, beloved of Vīrabhadra, beneficent, / Bhadrakālī, mother of the universe, granting welfare to her devotees.

1.11.s:
karālā piṅgalākārā nāmabhedāmahāmadā /
yaśasvinī yaśodā ca ṣaḍadhvaparivartikā //
1.11.d:
कराला पिङ्गलाकारा नामभेदामहामदा ।
यशस्विनी यशोदा च षडध्वपरिवर्तिका ॥
1.11.m: Terrifying, of tawny appearance, of diverse names, immensely impassioned, / renowned, bestower of fame, traversing the six paths.

1.11.s:
śaṅkhinī padminī sāṃkhyā sāṃkhyayogapravartikā /
caitrā saṃvatsarārūḍhā jagatsaṃpūraṇīndrajā //
1.11.d:
शङ्खिनी पद्मिनी सांख्या सांख्ययोगप्रवर्तिका ।
चैत्रा संवत्सरारूढा जगत्संपूरणीन्द्रजा ॥
1.11.m: Bearer of the conch, Padminī, Sāṃkhya, promulgator of Sāṃkhya and Yoga, / the month of Caitra, mounted upon the year, replenisher of the universe, daughter of Indra.

1.11.s:
śumbhāriḥ khecarīsvasthā kambugrīvā kalipriyā /
khagadhvajī khagārūḍhā parārghyā paramālinī //
1.11.d:
शुम्भारिः खेचरीस्वस्था कम्बुग्रीवा कलिप्रिया ।
खगध्वजी खगारूढा परार्घ्या परमालिनी ॥
1.11.m: Enemy of Śumbha, flying in the sky, self-reliant, conch-necked, fond of strife, / having a bird banner, mounted on a bird, supremely worthy, wearing the supreme garland.

1.11.s:
aiśvaryavartmanilayā viraktā garuḍāsanā /
jayantī hṛdguhā ramyā gahvireṣṭhā gaṇāgraṇīḥ //
1.11.d:
ऐश्वर्यवर्त्मनिलया विरक्ता गरुडासना ।
जयन्ती हृद्गुहा रम्या गह्विरेष्ठा गणाग्रणीः ॥
1.11.m: Dwelling in the path of sovereignty, detached, seated on Garuḍa, / victorious, the heart's cave, delightful, dwelling in the abyss, foremost of the celestial hosts.

1.11.s:
saṃkalpasiddhā sāmyasthā sarvavijñānadāyinī /
kalikalpaṣahantrī ca guhyopaniṣaduttamā //
1.11.d:
संकल्पसिद्धा साम्यस्था सर्वविज्ञानदायिनी ।
कलिकल्पषहन्त्री च गुह्योपनिषदुत्तमा ॥
1.11.m: Perfected by will, established in equanimity, giver of all higher knowledge, / destroyer of the impurities of the Kali age, the supreme secret Upaniṣad.

1.11.s:
niṣṭhā dṛṣṭiḥ smṛtirvyāptiḥ puṣṭistuṣṭiḥ kriyāvatī /
viśvāmareśvareśānā bhuktirmuktīḥ śivāmṛtā //
1.11.d:
निष्ठा दृष्टिः स्मृतिर्व्याप्तिः पुष्टिस्तुष्टिः क्रियावती ।
विश्वामरेश्वरेशाना भुक्तिर्मुक्तीः शिवामृता ॥
1.11.m: Steadfast faith, vision, memory, all-pervasiveness, nourishment, contentment, full of action, / the ruler of all immortals, enjoyment, liberation, the auspicious nectar.

1.11.s:
lohitā sarpamālā ca bhīṣaṇī vanamālinī /
anantaśayanānanyā naranārāyaṇodbhavā //
1.11.d:
लोहिता सर्पमाला च भीषणी वनमालिनी ।
अनन्तशयनानन्या नरनारायणोद्भवा ॥
1.11.m: Red, garlanded with serpents, terrible, wearing a garland of forest flowers, / reclining on Ananta, without another, born of Nara and Nārāyaṇa.

1.11.s:
nṛsiṃhī daityamathanī śaṅkhacakragadādharā /
saṃkarṣaṇasamutpattirambikāpādasaṃśrayā //
1.11.d:
नृसिंही दैत्यमथनी शङ्खचक्रगदाधरा ।
संकर्षणसमुत्पत्तिरम्बिकापादसंश्रया ॥
1.11.m: Nṛsiṃhī, slayer of Daityas, bearer of the conch, discus, and mace, / the origin of Saṃkarṣaṇa, taking shelter at Ambikā's feet.

1.11.s:
mahājvālā mahāmūrtiḥ sumūrtiḥ sarvakāmadhuk /
suprabhā sustanā gaurī dharmakāmārthamokṣadā //
1.11.d:
महाज्वाला महामूर्तिः सुमूर्तिः सर्वकामधुक् ।
सुप्रभा सुस्तना गौरी धर्मकामार्थमोक्षदा ॥
1.11.m: Great flame, great form, beautiful form, the cow that yields all desires, / beautifully radiant, having lovely breasts, Gaurī, granting duty, desire, wealth, and liberation.

1.11.s:
bhrūmadhyanilayā pūrvā purāṇapuruṣāraṇiḥ /
mahāvibhūtidā madhyā sarojanayanā samā //
1.11.d:
भ्रूमध्यनिलया पूर्वा पुराणपुरुषारणिः ।
महाविभूतिदा मध्या सरोजनयना समा ॥
1.11.m: Dwelling between the eyebrows, ancient, the fire-drill producing the ancient Spirit, / giver of great power, central, lotus-eyed, even-minded.

1.11.s:
aṣṭādaśabhujānādyā nīlotpaladalaprabhā /
sarvaśaktyāsanārūḍhā dharmādharmārthavarjitā //
1.11.d:
अष्टादशभुजानाद्या नीलोत्पलदलप्रभा ।
सर्वशक्त्यासनारूढा धर्माधर्मार्थवर्जिता ॥
1.11.m: Eighteen-armed, primordial, radiant like a blue lotus petal, / seated upon the throne of all powers, free from dharma, adharma, and wealth.

1.11.s:
vairāgyajñānaniratā nirālokā nirindriyā /
vicitragahanādhārā śāśvatasthānavāsinī //
1.11.d:
वैराग्यज्ञाननिरता निरालोका निरिन्द्रिया ।
विचित्रगहनाधारा शाश्वतस्थानवासिनी ॥
1.11.m: Devoted to detachment and knowledge, sightless, without sense faculties, / the varied support of the deep abyss, dwelling in the eternal abode.

1.11.s:
sthāneśvarī nirānandā triśūlavaradhāriṇī /
aśeṣadevatāmūrtirdevatā varadevatā /
gaṇāmbikā gireḥ putrī niśumbhavinipātinī //
1.11.d:
स्थानेश्वरी निरानन्दा त्रिशूलवरधारिणी ।
अशेषदेवतामूर्तिर्देवता वरदेवता ।
गणाम्बिका गिरेः पुत्री निशुम्भविनिपातिनी ॥
1.11.m: Ruler of sacred places, free from joy, holding the excellent trident, / the form of all deities, deity, the supreme deity, / mother of the celestial hosts, daughter of the mountain, slayer of Niśumbha.

1.11.s:
avarṇa varṇarahitā nivarṇā bījasaṃbhavā /
anantavarṇānanyasthā śaṅkarī śāntamānasā //
1.11.d:
अवर्ण वर्णरहिता निवर्णा बीजसंभवा ।
अनन्तवर्णानन्यस्था शङ्करी शान्तमानसा ॥
1.11.m: Formless, devoid of color, without caste, born of the seed-syllable, / of endless colors, resting in none other, beneficent, of tranquil mind.

1.11.s:
agotrā gomatī goptrī guhyarūpā guṇottarā /
gaurgorgavyapriyā gauṇī gaṇeśvaranamaskṛtā //
1.11.d:
अगोत्रा गोमती गोप्त्री गुह्यरूपा गुणोत्तरा ।
गौर्गोर्गव्यप्रिया गौणी गणेश्वरनमस्कृता ॥
1.11.m: Without lineage, rich in cattle, protectress, secret of form, superior in virtue, / the earth, speech, fond of cow products, composed of qualities, saluted by the lord of Gaṇas.

1.11.s:
satyamātrā satyasaṃdhā trisaṃdhyā saṃdhivarjitā /
sarvavādāśrayā saṃkhyā saṃkhyayogasamudbhavā //
1.11.d:
सत्यमात्रा सत्यसंधा त्रिसंध्या संधिवर्जिता ।
सर्ववादाश्रया संख्या संख्ययोगसमुद्भवा ॥
1.11.m: Truth alone, true to her promise, the three junctures of the day, free from transitions, / refuge of all doctrines, counting, born from Sāṃkhya and Yoga.

1.11.s:
asaṃkhyeyāprameyākhyā śūnyā śuddhakulodbhavā /
bindunādasamutpattiḥ śaṃbhuvāmā śaśiprabhā //
1.11.d:
असंख्येयाप्रमेयाख्या शून्या शुद्धकुलोद्भवा ।
बिन्दुनादसमुत्पत्तिः शंभुवामा शशिप्रभा ॥
1.11.m: Innumerable, named the immeasurable, the void, born of a pure lineage, / origin of the point and sound, the left side of Śambhu, radiant as the moon.

1.11.s:
visaṅgā bhedarahitā manojñā madhusūdanī /
mahāśrīḥ śrīsamutpattistamaḥ pāre pratiṣṭhitā //
1.11.d:
विसङ्गा भेदरहिता मनोज्ञा मधुसूदनी ।
महाश्रीः श्रीसमुत्पत्तिस्तमः पारे प्रतिष्ठिता ॥
1.11.m: Unattached, free from differentiation, charming, slayer of Madhu, / great Lakṣmī, origin of Śrī, established beyond darkness.

1.11.s:
tritattvamātā trividhā susūkṣmapadasaṃśrayā /
śāntyatītā malātītā nirvikārā nirāśrayā //
1.11.d:
त्रितत्त्वमाता त्रिविधा सुसूक्ष्मपदसंश्रया ।
शान्त्यतीता मलातीता निर्विकारा निराश्रया ॥
1.11.m: Mother of the three principles, threefold, resting upon the extremely subtle state, / beyond peace, beyond taint, changeless, without support.

1.11.s:
śivākhyā cittanilayā śivajñānasvarūpiṇī /
daityadānavanirmātrī kāśyapī kālakalpikā //
1.11.d:
शिवाख्या चित्तनिलया शिवज्ञानस्वरूपिणी ।
दैत्यदानवनिर्मात्री काश्यपी कालकल्पिका ॥
1.11.m: Named Śivā, dwelling in the intellect, whose nature is knowledge of Śiva, / creator of Daityas and Dānavas, daughter of Kaśyapa, conceiver of time.

1.11.s:
śāstrayoniḥ kriyāmūrtiścaturvargapradarśikā /
nārāyaṇī narodbhūtiḥ kaumudī liṅgadhāriṇī //
1.11.d:
शास्त्रयोनिः क्रियामूर्तिश्चतुर्वर्गप्रदर्शिका ।
नारायणी नरोद्भूतिः कौमुदी लिङ्गधारिणी ॥
1.11.m: Source of sacred scriptures, embodiment of action, revealer of the four human goals, / Nārāyaṇī, arising from man, moonlit brilliance, bearer of the liṅga.

1.11.s:
kāmukī lalitā bhāvā parāparavibhūtidā /
parāntajātamahimā baḍavā vāmalocanā //
1.11.d:
कामुकी ललिता भावा परापरविभूतिदा ।
परान्तजातमहिमा बडवा वामलोचना ॥
1.11.m: Full of love, graceful, emotion itself, giver of higher and lower glory, / whose majesty transcends the ultimate, the submarine fire, lovely-eyed.

1.11.s:
subhadrā devakī sītā vedavedāṅgapāragā /
manasvinī manyumātā mahāmanyusamudbhavā //
1.11.d:
सुभद्रा देवकी सीता वेदवेदाङ्गपारगा ।
मनस्विनी मन्युमाता महामन्युसमुद्भवा ॥
1.11.m: Subhadrā, Devakī, Sītā, crossing to the further shore of the Vedas and auxiliary sciences, / resolute, mother of wrath, born of mighty fury.

1.11.s:
amṛtyuramṛtā svāhā puruhūtā puruṣṭutā /
aśocyā bhinnaviṣayā hiraṇyarajatapriyā //
1.11.d:
अमृत्युरमृता स्वाहा पुरुहूता पुरुष्टुता ।
अशोच्या भिन्नविषया हिरण्यरजतप्रिया ॥
1.11.m: Freedom from death, immortal, Svāhā, invoked by many, praised by many, / beyond sorrow, having distinct objects of perception, fond of gold and silver.

1.11.s:
hiraṇyā rājatī haimī hemābharaṇabhūṣitā /
vibhrājamānā durjñeyā jyotiṣṭomaphalapradā //
1.11.d:
हिरण्या राजती हैमी हेमाभरणभूषिता ।
विभ्राजमाना दुर्ज्ञेया ज्योतिष्टोमफलप्रदा ॥
1.11.m: Golden, silvery, made of gold, adorned with gold ornaments, / brilliantly shining, hard to know, bestowing the fruit of the Jyotiṣṭoma sacrifice.

1.11.s:
mahānidrāsamudbhūtiranidrā satyadevatā /
dīrghākakudminī hṛdyā śāntidā śāntivardhinī //
1.11.d:
महानिद्रासमुद्भूतिरनिद्रा सत्यदेवता ।
दीर्घाककुद्मिनी हृद्या शान्तिदा शान्तिवर्धिनी ॥
1.11.m: Born of the great cosmic sleep, sleepless, the goddess of truth, / long-limbed, bearing a crown, delightful, giver of peace, increaser of peace.

1.11.s:
lakṣmyādiśaktijananī śakticakrapravartikā /
triśaktijananī janyā ṣaḍūrmiparirjitā //
1.11.d:
लक्ष्म्यादिशक्तिजननी शक्तिचक्रप्रवर्तिका ।
त्रिशक्तिजननी जन्या षडूर्मिपरिर्जिता ॥
1.11.m: Mother of powers beginning with Lakṣmī, setting the circle of powers into motion, / mother of the three powers, to be produced, free from the six waves of mortal life.

1.11.s:
sudhāmā karmakaraṇī yugāntadahanātmikā /
saṃkarṣaṇī jagaddhātrī kāmayoniḥ kirīṭinī //
1.11.d:
सुधामा कर्मकरणी युगान्तदहनात्मिका ।
संकर्षणी जगद्धात्री कामयोनिः किरीटिनी ॥
1.11.m: Of fair dwelling, performer of deeds, having the nature of the fire at the end of an aeon, / Saṃkarṣaṇī, sustainer of the world, womb of desires, crowned with a diadem.

1.11.s:
aindrī trailokyanamitā vaiṣṇavī parameśvarī /
pradyumnadayitā dāntā yugmadṛṣṭistrilocanā //
1.11.d:
ऐन्द्री त्रैलोक्यनमिता वैष्णवी परमेश्वरी ।
प्रद्युम्नदयिता दान्ता युग्मदृष्टिस्त्रिलोचना ॥
1.11.m: Indra's power, bowed to by the three worlds, Vaiṣṇavī, supreme sovereign, / beloved of Pradyumna, self-controlled, double-sighted, three-eyed.

1.11.s:
madotkaṭā haṃsagatiḥ pracaṇḍā caṇḍavikramā /
vṛṣāveśā viyanmātā vindhyaparvatavāsinī //
1.11.d:
मदोत्कटा हंसगतिः प्रचण्डा चण्डविक्रमा ।
वृषावेशा वियन्माता विन्ध्यपर्वतवासिनी ॥
1.11.m: Exultant with pride, whose gait is like a swan's, fierce, of fierce valor, / mounted on a bull, mother of the sky, dweller on the Vindhya mountains.

1.11.s:
himavanmerunilayā kailāsagirivāsinī /
cāṇūrahantṛtanayā nītijñā kāmarūpiṇī //
1.11.d:
हिमवन्मेरुनिलया कैलासगिरिवासिनी ।
चाणूरहन्तृतनया नीतिज्ञा कामरूपिणी ॥
1.11.m: Dwelling on the Himavat and Meru, dweller on Mount Kailāsa, / daughter of the slayer of Cāṇūra, skilled in counsel, assuming forms at will.

1.11.s:
vedavidyāvratasnātā dharmaśīlānilāśanā /
vīrabhadrapriyā vīrā mahākālasamudbhavā //
1.11.d:
वेदविद्याव्रतस्नाता धर्मशीलानिलाशना ।
वीरभद्रप्रिया वीरा महाकालसमुद्भवा ॥
1.11.m: She who has performed the ablution of Vedic learning and vows, of righteous conduct, feeder on air, / beloved of Vīrabhadra, heroic, born of Mahākāla;

1.11.s:
vidyādharapriyā siddhā vidyādharanirākṛtiḥ /
āpyāyanī harantī ca pāvanī poṣaṇī khilā //
1.11.d:
विद्याधरप्रिया सिद्धा विद्याधरनिराकृतिः ।
आप्यायनी हरन्ती च पावनी पोषणी खिला ॥
1.11.m: beloved of the Vidyādharas, perfected, of Vidyādhara form, / invigorating, seizing away, purifying, nourishing, all-inclusive;

1.11.s:
mātṛkā manmathodbhūtā vārijā vāhanapriyā /
karīṣiṇī sudhāvāṇī vīṇāvādanatatparā //
1.11.d:
मातृका मन्मथोद्भूता वारिजा वाहनप्रिया ।
करीषिणी सुधावाणी वीणावादनतत्परा ॥
1.11.m: Mother, born of Love, born from water, fond of vehicles, / rich in dung, sweet-spoken, devoted to playing the lute;

1.11.s:
sevitā sevikā sevyā sinīvālī garutmatī /
arundhatī hiraṇyākṣī mṛgāṅkā mānadāyinī //
1.11.d:
सेविता सेविका सेव्या सिनीवाली गरुत्मती ।
अरुन्धती हिरण्याक्षी मृगाङ्का मानदायिनी ॥
1.11.m: served, serving, worthy to be served, the new moon day, winged, / Arundhatī, golden-eyed, deer-marked, bestower of honor;

1.11.s:
vasupradā vasumatī vasordhārā vasuṃdharā /
dhārādharā varārohā varāvarasahastradā //
1.11.d:
वसुप्रदा वसुमती वसोर्धारा वसुंधरा ।
धाराधरा वरारोहा वरावरसहस्त्रदा ॥
1.11.m: giver of wealth, possessing wealth, stream of treasures, bearer of wealth, / cloud, possessing splendid hips, giver of a thousand superior and inferior things;

1.11.s:
śrīphalā śrīmatī śrīśā śrīnivāsā śivapriyā /
śrīdharā śrīkarī kalyā śrīdharārdhaśarīriṇī //
1.11.d:
श्रीफला श्रीमती श्रीशा श्रीनिवासा शिवप्रिया ।
श्रीधरा श्रीकरी कल्या श्रीधरार्धशरीरिणी ॥
1.11.m: bearing fortunate fruit, prosperous, goddess of fortune, abode of Śrī, beloved of Śiva, / bearing Śrī, bringing fortune, auspicious, half of the body of the bearer of Śrī;

1.11.s:
anantadṛṣṭirakṣudrā dhātrīśā dhanadapriyā /
nihantrī daityasaṅghānāṃ sihikā sihavāhanā //
1.11.d:
अनन्तदृष्टिरक्षुद्रा धात्रीशा धनदप्रिया ।
निहन्त्री दैत्यसङ्घानां सिहिका सिहवाहना ॥
1.11.m: of boundless sight, not small, ruler of the earth, beloved of the giver of wealth, / slayer of the hordes of Daityas, lioness, riding a lion;

1.11.s:
suṣeṇā candranilayā sukīrtiśchinnasaṃśayā /
rasajñā rasadā rāmā lelihānāmṛtastravā //
1.11.d:
सुषेणा चन्द्रनिलया सुकीर्तिश्छिन्नसंशया ।
रसज्ञा रसदा रामा लेलिहानामृतस्त्रवा ॥
1.11.m: having a good army, dwelling in the moon, having good renown, free from doubts, / knower of essences, giver of rasas, delightful, licking, oozing nectar;

1.11.s:
nityoditā svayañjyotirutsukā mṛtajīvanī /
vajradaṇḍā vajrajihvā vaidevī vajravigrahā //
1.11.d:
नित्योदिता स्वयञ्ज्योतिरुत्सुका मृतजीवनी ।
वज्रदण्डा वज्रजिह्वा वैदेवी वज्रविग्रहा ॥
1.11.m: ever risen, self-luminous, eager, reviving the dead, / having a staff like a thunderbolt, thunderbolt-tongued, celestial goddess, having a body of thunderbolt;

1.11.s:
maṅgalyā maṅgalā mālā malinā malahāriṇī /
gāndharvo gāruḍī cāndrī kambalāśvatarapriyā //
1.11.d:
मङ्गल्या मङ्गला माला मलिना मलहारिणी ।
गान्धर्वो गारुडी चान्द्री कम्बलाश्वतरप्रिया ॥
1.11.m: auspicious, fortune itself, garland, sullied, remover of taint, / skilled in Gandharva lore, mistress of Garuda lore, lunar, beloved of Kambala and Aśvatara;

1.11.s:
saudāminī janānandā bhrukuṭīkuṭilānanā /
karṇikārakarā kakṣyā kaṃsaprāṇāpahāriṇī //
1.11.d:
सौदामिनी जनानन्दा भ्रुकुटीकुटिलानना ।
कर्णिकारकरा कक्ष्या कंसप्राणापहारिणी ॥
1.11.m: lightning, joy of the people, her face curved with knitted brows, / having hands like the Karṇikāra, waistband, snatcher of the life of Kaṃsa;

1.11.s:
yugandharā yugāvartā trisaṃdhyā harṣavardhanī /
pratyakṣadevatā divyā divyagandhā divāparā //
1.11.d:
युगन्धरा युगावर्ता त्रिसंध्या हर्षवर्धनी ।
प्रत्यक्षदेवता दिव्या दिव्यगन्धा दिवापरा ॥
1.11.m: bearing the yoke, cycle of ages, the three twilights, increaser of joy, / perceptible deity, divine, of divine fragrance, surpassing the day;

1.11.s:
śakrāsanagatā śākrī sādhvī nārī śavāsanā /
iṣṭā viśiṣṭā śiṣṭeṣṭā śiṣṭāśiṣṭaprapūjitā //
1.11.d:
शक्रासनगता शाक्री साध्वी नारी शवासना ।
इष्टा विशिष्टा शिष्टेष्टा शिष्टाशिष्टप्रपूजिता ॥
1.11.m: seated on Indra's throne, Śakrī, chaste woman, seated upon a corpse, / desired, distinguished, beloved of the cultured, worshipped by the cultured and the uncultured;

1.11.s:
śatarūpā śatāvartā vinatā surabhiḥ surā /
surendramātā sudyumnā suṣumnā sūryasaṃsthitā //
1.11.d:
शतरूपा शतावर्ता विनता सुरभिः सुरा ।
सुरेन्द्रमाता सुद्युम्ना सुषुम्ना सूर्यसंस्थिता ॥
1.11.m: having a hundred forms, hundred-curled, humble, fragrant cow, celestial wine, / mother of the king of the gods, Sudyumna, the Suṣumnā channel, dwelling in the sun;

1.11.s:
samīkṣyā satpratiṣṭhā ca nivṛttirjñānapāragā /
dharmaśāstrārthakuśalā dharmajñā dharmavāhanā //
1.11.d:
समीक्ष्या सत्प्रतिष्ठा च निवृत्तिर्ज्ञानपारगा ।
धर्मशास्त्रार्थकुशला धर्मज्ञा धर्मवाहना ॥
1.11.m: to be examined, foundation of the real, renunciation, gone to the farther shore of knowledge, / skilled in the meaning of treatises on duty, knower of righteousness, riding upon righteousness;

1.11.s:
dharmādharmavinirmātrī dhārmikāṇāṃ śivapradā /
dharmaśaktirdharmamayī vidharmā viśvadharmiṇī //
1.11.d:
धर्माधर्मविनिर्मात्री धार्मिकाणां शिवप्रदा ।
धर्मशक्तिर्धर्ममयी विधर्मा विश्वधर्मिणी ॥
1.11.m: maker of virtue and vice, granter of auspiciousness to the righteous, / power of righteousness, composed of righteousness, free from duty, possessing the nature of all things;

1.11.s:
dharmāntarā dharmameghā dharmapūrvā dhanāvahā /
dharmopadeṣṭrī dharmatmā dharmagamyā dharādharā //
1.11.d:
धर्मान्तरा धर्ममेघा धर्मपूर्वा धनावहा ।
धर्मोपदेष्ट्री धर्मत्मा धर्मगम्या धराधरा ॥
1.11.m: inner duty, cloud of virtue, preceding duty, bearer of wealth, / teacher of duty, soul of righteousness, reachable through duty, bearer of the earth;

1.11.s:
kāpālī śākalā mūrtiḥ kalā kalitavigrahā /
sarvaśaktivinirmuktā sarvaśaktyāśrayāśrayā //
1.11.d:
कापाली शाकला मूर्तिः कला कलितविग्रहा ।
सर्वशक्तिविनिर्मुक्ता सर्वशक्त्याश्रयाश्रया ॥
1.11.m: bearer of skulls, whose form is the Śākala recension, a fraction of time, whose body is composed [of parts], / freed from all powers, the resting-place of the foundation of all powers;

1.11.s:
sarvā sarveśvarī sūkṣmā susūkṣmā jñānarūpiṇī /
pradhānapuruṣeśeśā mahādevaikasākṣiṇī /
sadāśivā viyanmūrtirviśvamūrtiramūrtikā //
1.11.d:
सर्वा सर्वेश्वरी सूक्ष्मा सुसूक्ष्मा ज्ञानरूपिणी ।
प्रधानपुरुषेशेशा महादेवैकसाक्षिणी ।
सदाशिवा वियन्मूर्तिर्विश्वमूर्तिरमूर्तिका ॥
1.11.m: all, sovereign of all, subtle, most subtle, having the form of knowledge, / sovereign over primordial matter, the spirit, and the Lord, sole witness of Mahādeva, / Sadāśivā, whose form is space, whose form is the universe, formless.

1.11.s:
evaṃ nāmnāṃ sahastreṇa stutvāsau himavān giriḥ /
bhūyaḥ praṇamya bhītātmā provācedaṃ kṛtāñjaliḥ //
1.11.d:
एवं नाम्नां सहस्त्रेण स्तुत्वासौ हिमवान् गिरिः ।
भूयः प्रणम्य भीतात्मा प्रोवाचेदं कृताञ्जलिः ॥
1.11.m: Having thus praised her with the thousand names, that mount Himavat, / bowing again with a fearful soul, said this with folded hands:

1.11.s:
yadetadaiśvaraṃ rūpaṃ ghoraṃ te parameśvari /
bhīto 'smi sāmprataṃ dṛṣṭvā rūpamanyat pradarśaya //
1.11.d:
यदेतदैश्वरं रूपं घोरं ते परमेश्वरि ।
भीतो ऽस्मि साम्प्रतं दृष्ट्वा रूपमन्यत् प्रदर्शय ॥
1.11.m: “O Supreme Sovereign, seeing this fearful, sovereign form of yours, / I am now terrified; reveal another form.”

1.11.s:
evamuktātha sā devī tena śailena pārvatī /
saṃhṛtya darśayāmāsa svarūpamaparaṃ punaḥ //
1.11.d:
एवमुक्ताथ सा देवी तेन शैलेन पार्वती ।
संहृत्य दर्शयामास स्वरूपमपरं पुनः ॥
1.11.m: Being thus addressed by that mountain, the goddess Pārvatī / withdrew [that form] and showed again her other, true form:

1.11.s:
nīlotpaladalaprakhyaṃ nīlotpalasugandhikam /
dvinetraṃ dvibhujaṃ saumyaṃ nīlālakavibhūṣitam //
1.11.d:
नीलोत्पलदलप्रख्यं नीलोत्पलसुगन्धिकम् ।
द्विनेत्रं द्विभुजं सौम्यं नीलालकविभूषितम् ॥
1.11.m: Resembling a blue lotus petal, fragrant as a blue lotus, / two-eyed, two-armed, gentle, adorned with dark ringlets of hair;

1.11.s:
raktapādāmbujatalaṃ suraktakarapallavam /
śrīmad viśālasaṃvṛttalalāṭatilakojjvalam //
1.11.d:
रक्तपादाम्बुजतलं सुरक्तकरपल्लवम् ।
श्रीमद् विशालसंवृत्तललाटतिलकोज्ज्वलम् ॥
1.11.m: the soles of her lotus feet red, her sprout-like hands very red, / glorious, radiant with an ornamental mark on a broad and rounded forehead;

1.11.s:
bhūṣitaṃ cārusarvāṅgaṃ bhūṣaṇairatikomalam /
dadhānamurasā mālāṃ viśālāṃ hemanirmitām //
1.11.d:
भूषितं चारुसर्वाङ्गं भूषणैरतिकोमलम् ।
दधानमुरसा मालां विशालां हेमनिर्मिताम् ॥
1.11.m: with all her beautiful limbs adorned with ornaments, exceedingly delicate, / wearing on her breast a broad garland made of gold;

1.11.s:
īṣatsmitaṃ suvimboṣṭhaṃ nūpurārāvasaṃyutam /
prasannavadanaṃ divyamanantamahimāspadam //
1.11.d:
ईषत्स्मितं सुविम्बोष्ठं नूपुरारावसंयुतम् ।
प्रसन्नवदनं दिव्यमनन्तमहिमास्पदम् ॥
1.11.m: with a faint smile, lips like the bimba fruit, accompanied by the sound of anklets, / serene-faced, divine, the abode of endless majesty.

1.11.s:
tadīdṛśaṃ samālokya svarūpaṃ śailasattamaḥ /
bhītiṃ saṃtyajya hṛṣṭātmā babhāṣe parameśvarīm //
1.11.d:
तदीदृशं समालोक्य स्वरूपं शैलसत्तमः ।
भीतिं संत्यज्य हृष्टात्मा बभाषे परमेश्वरीम् ॥
1.11.m: Beholding such an intrinsic form, the best of mountains, / casting aside fear, his soul filled with joy, addressed the Supreme Sovereign:

1.11.s:
himavānuvāca
adya me saphalaṃ janma adya me saphalaṃ tapaḥ /
yanme sākṣāt tvamavyaktāprasannā dṛṣṭigocarā //
1.11.d:
हिमवानुवाच
अद्य मे सफलं जन्म अद्य मे सफलं तपः ।
यन्मे साक्षात् त्वमव्यक्ताप्रसन्ना दृष्टिगोचरा ॥
1.11.m:
Himavat said:
“Today my birth has borne fruit; today my asceticism has borne fruit, / since you, unmanifest and gracious, have appeared before my very eyes.

1.11.s:
tvayā sṛṣṭaṃ jagat sarvaṃ pradhānādyantvayi sthitam /
tvayyeva līyate devi tvameva ca parā gatiḥ //
1.11.d:
त्वया सृष्टं जगत् सर्वं प्रधानाद्यन्त्वयि स्थितम् ।
त्वय्येव लीयते देवि त्वमेव च परा गतिः ॥
1.11.m: All this world beginning with primordial matter is created by you and abides in you; / into you alone it dissolves, O goddess, and you alone are the supreme goal.

1.11.s:
vadanti kecit tvāmeva prakṛtiṃ prakṛteḥ parām /
apare paramārthajñāḥ śiveti śivasaṃśraye //
1.11.d:
वदन्ति केचित् त्वामेव प्रकृतिं प्रकृतेः पराम् ।
अपरे परमार्थज्ञाः शिवेति शिवसंश्रये ॥
1.11.m: Some speak of you as primordial matter, [others as] beyond primordial matter; / others, knowing the highest reality, [speak of you] as Śivā, O refuge of Śiva.

1.11.s:
tvayi pradhānaṃ puruṣo mahān brahmā tatheśvaraḥ /
avidyā niyatirmāyā kalādyāḥ śataśo 'bhavan //
1.11.d:
त्वयि प्रधानं पुरुषो महान् ब्रह्मा तथेश्वरः ।
अविद्या नियतिर्माया कलाद्याः शतशो ऽभवन् ॥
1.11.m: In you arose by the hundreds primordial matter, the spirit, the intellect, Brahmā, and likewise the Lord, / ignorance, cosmic order, illusory creative power, parts of time, and the rest.

1.11.s:
tvaṃ hi sā paramā śaktiranantā parameṣṭhinī /
sarvabhedavinirmuktā sarvebhedāśrayā nijā //
1.11.d:
त्वं हि सा परमा शक्तिरनन्ता परमेष्ठिनी ।
सर्वभेदविनिर्मुक्ता सर्वेभेदाश्रया निजा ॥
1.11.m: For you are that supreme power, endless, supreme, / freed from all distinctions, the resting-place of all distinctions, his own [power].

1.11.s:
tvāmadhiṣṭhāya yogeśi mahādevo maheśvaraḥ /
pradhānādyaṃ jagat kṛtsnaṃ karoti vikaroti ca //
1.11.d:
त्वामधिष्ठाय योगेशि महादेवो महेश्वरः ।
प्रधानाद्यं जगत् कृत्स्नं करोति विकरोति च ॥
1.11.m: Resting upon you, O mistress of yoga, Mahādeva, the Great Lord, / creates and transforms the entire world beginning with primordial matter.

1.11.s:
tvayaiva saṃgato devaḥ svamānandaṃ samaśnute /
tvameva paramānandastvamevānandadāyinī //
1.11.d:
त्वयैव संगतो देवः स्वमानन्दं समश्नुते ।
त्वमेव परमानन्दस्त्वमेवानन्ददायिनी ॥
1.11.m: Joined with you alone does the god experience his own bliss; / you alone are supreme bliss, you alone are the giver of bliss.

1.11.s:
tvamakṣaraṃ paraṃ vyoma mahajjyotirnirañjanam /
śivaṃ sarvagataṃ sūkṣmaṃ paraṃ brahmā sanātanam //
1.11.d:
त्वमक्षरं परं व्योम महज्ज्योतिर्निरञ्जनम् ।
शिवं सर्वगतं सूक्ष्मं परं ब्रह्मा सनातनम् ॥
1.11.m: You are the imperishable, the supreme sky, the great light free from taint, / Śiva, all-pervading, subtle, the supreme, eternal Brahman.

1.11.s:
tvaṃ śakraḥ sarvadevānāṃ brahmā brahmavidāmasi /
vāyurbalavatāṃ devi yogināṃ tvaṃ kumārakaḥ //
1.11.d:
त्वं शक्रः सर्वदेवानां ब्रह्मा ब्रह्मविदामसि ।
वायुर्बलवतां देवि योगिनां त्वं कुमारकः ॥
1.11.m: Among all the gods you are Śakra; among knowers of Brahman you are Brahmā; / among the strong, O goddess, you are the Wind; among yogins you are Sanatkumāra.

1.11.s:
ṛṣīṇāṃ ca vasiṣṭhastvaṃ vyāso vedavidāmasi /
sāṃkhyānāṃ kapilo devo rudrāṇāmasi śaṅkaraḥ //
1.11.d:
ऋषीणां च वसिष्ठस्त्वं व्यासो वेदविदामसि ।
सांख्यानां कपिलो देवो रुद्राणामसि शङ्करः ॥
1.11.m: Among sages you are Vasiṣṭha; among knowers of the Veda you are Vyāsa; / among the followers of Sāṅkhya you are the divine Kapila; among the Rudras you are Śaṅkara.

1.11.s:
ādityānāmupendrastvaṃ vasūnāṃ caiva pāvakaḥ /
vedānāṃ sāmavedastvaṃ gāyatrī chandasāmasi //
1.11.d:
आदित्यानामुपेन्द्रस्त्वं वसूनां चैव पावकः ।
